sections.label: An accompaniment to the offering of a Mixt Oblation
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 1

verses.sa:
सं सं स्रवन्तु नद्यः१ सं वाताः सं पतत्रिणः ।
यज्ञमिमं वर्धयता गिरः संस्राव्येऽण हविषा जुहोमि॥
verses.tr: saṃ saṃ sravantu nadyaḥ1 saṃ vātāḥ saṃ patatriṇaḥ yajñamimaṃ vardhayatā giraḥ saṃsrāvye'ṇa haviṣā juhomi
verses.en: Let the streams flow together, let the winds and birds assembled come. Strengthen this sacrifice of mine, ye singers, I offer up a duly mixt oblation,

verses.sa:
इमं होमा यज्ञमवतेमं संस्रावणा उत।
यज्ञमिमं वर्धयता गिरः संस्राव्येऽण हविषा जुहोमि॥
verses.tr: imaṃ homā yajñamavatemaṃ saṃsrāvaṇā uta yajñamimaṃ vardhayatā giraḥ saṃsrāvye'ṇa haviṣā juhomi
verses.en: O Burnt Oblations, aid, and ye, Blent Offerings, this my sacrifice, Strengthen this sacrifice of mine, ye singers, I offer up a duly mixt oblation.

verses.sa:
रूपंरूपं वयोवयः संरभ्यैनं परि ष्वजे ।
यज्ञमिमं चतस्रः प्रदिशो वर्धयन्तु संस्राव्येऽण हविषा जुहोमि॥
verses.tr: rūpaṃrūpaṃ vayovayaḥ saṃrabhyainaṃ pari ṣvaje yajñamimaṃ catasraḥ pradiśo vardhayantu saṃsrāvye'ṇa haviṣā juhomi
verses.en: Each several form, each several force I seize, and compass round this man, May the Four Quarters strengthen this my sacrifice. I offer up a duly mixt oblation,

sections.label: A hymn to all Waters
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 2

verses.sa:
शं त आपो हैमवतीः शमु ते सन्तूत्स्याः ।
शं ते सनिष्यदा आपः शमु ते सन्तु वर्ष्याः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ ta āpo haimavatīḥ śamu te santūtsyāḥ śaṃ te saniṣyadā āpaḥ śamu te santu varṣyāḥ
verses.en: Blest be the Streams from hills of snow, sweet be spring Waters unto thee, Sweet be swift-running Waters, sweet to thee be

verses.sa:
शं त आपो धन्वन्याः३ शं ते सन्त्वनूप्याः ।
शं ते खनित्रिमा आपः शं याः कुम्भेभिराभृताः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ ta āpo dhanvanyāḥ3 śaṃ te santvanūpyāḥ śaṃ te khanitrimā āpaḥ śaṃ yāḥ kumbhebhirābhṛtāḥ
verses.en: Sweet unto thee be Waters of the waste and Waters of the pool, Sweet be the Waters dug from earth, to thee, and: Waters brought in jars.

verses.sa:
अनभ्रयः खनमाना विप्रा गम्भीरे अपसः ।
भिषग्भ्यो भिषक्तरा आपो अच्छा वदामसि॥
verses.tr: anabhrayaḥ khanamānā viprā gambhīre apasaḥ bhiṣagbhyo bhiṣaktarā āpo acchā vadāmasi
verses.en: To those who delve without a tool to dig, the wise, the deeply moved, To Waters better healers than physicians we address our prayer,

verses.sa:
अपामह दिव्याऽनामपां स्रोतस्याऽनाम्।
अपामह प्रणेजनेऽश्वा भवथ वाजिनः॥
verses.tr: apāmaha divyā'nāmapāṃ srotasyā'nām apāmaha praṇejane'śvā bhavatha vājinaḥ
verses.en: Bathed in the Waters verily divine, in water of the streams, Bathed in the Waters verily, O Horses, be ye fleet and strong.

verses.sa:
ता अपः शिवा अपोऽयक्ष्मंकरणीरपः ।
यथैव तृप्यते मयस्तास्त आ दत्त भेषजीः॥
verses.tr: tā apaḥ śivā apo'yakṣmaṃkaraṇīrapaḥ yathaiva tṛpyate mayastāsta ā datta bheṣajīḥ
verses.en: Blest be the Waters unto thee, auspious Waters, bringing health. They cure the injured place for thee even as thy comfort craveth it,

sections.label: A hymn to Agni for protection and prosperity
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 3

verses.sa:
दिवस्पृथिव्याः पर्यन्तरिक्षाद् वनस्पतिभ्यो अध्योषधीभ्यः ।
यत्रयत्र विभृतो जातवेदास्तत स्तुतो जुषमाणो न एहि॥
verses.tr: divaspṛthivyāḥ paryantarikṣād vanaspatibhyo adhyoṣadhībhyaḥ yatrayatra vibhṛto jātavedāstata stuto juṣamāṇo na ehi
verses.en: Whithersoe'er, from sky, earth, air's mid-region, from plants and herbs, from tall trees, Jatavedas Is carried here and there to divers places, even thence come thou to us with loving-kindness.

verses.sa:
यस्ते अप्सु महिमा यो वनेषु य ओषधीषु पशुष्वप्स्व१न्तः ।
अग्ने सर्वास्तन्वः१ सं रभस्व ताभिर्न एहि द्रविणोदा अजस्रः॥
verses.tr: yaste apsu mahimā yo vaneṣu ya oṣadhīṣu paśuṣvapsva1ntaḥ agne sarvāstanvaḥ1 saṃ rabhasva tābhirna ehi draviṇodā ajasraḥ
verses.en: All majesty of thine in floods, in forest, in plants, in cattle, in the depths of waters—Closely uniting all thy forms, O Agni, come unto us wealth-giving, undecaying.

verses.sa:
यस्ते देवेषु महिमा स्वर्गो या ते तनूः पितृष्वाविवेश ।
पुष्टिर्या ते मनुष्येऽषु पप्रथेऽग्ने तया रयिमस्मासु धेहि॥
verses.tr: yaste deveṣu mahimā svargo yā te tanūḥ pitṛṣvāviveśa puṣṭiryā te manuṣye'ṣu paprathe'gne tayā rayimasmāsu dhehi
verses.en: Thy majesty among the Gods in Svarga, thy body which hath past into the Fathers, Thy plenty far-diffused mid human beings, even with this, O Agni, give us riches.

verses.sa:
श्रुत्कर्णाय कवये वेद्याय वचोभिर्वाकैरुप यामि रातिम्।
यतो भयमभयं तन्नो अस्त्वव देवानां यज हेडो अग्ने॥
verses.tr: śrutkarṇāya kavaye vedyāya vacobhirvākairupa yāmi rātim yato bhayamabhayaṃ tanno astvava devānāṃ yaja heḍo agne
verses.en: To him the wise, the famous, swift to listen, with words and verses I come nigh for bounty. May we be safe from threatening danger, Soften by sacrifice the wrath of Gods, O Agni.

sections.label: A prayer, accompanying sacrifice, for the attainment of a wish
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 4

verses.sa:
यामाहुतिं प्रथमामथर्वा या जाता या हव्यमकृणोज्जातवेदाः ।
तां त एतां प्रथमो जोहवीमि ताभिष्टुप्तो वहतु हव्यमग्निरग्नये स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yāmāhutiṃ prathamāmatharvā yā jātā yā havyamakṛṇojjātavedāḥ tāṃ ta etāṃ prathamo johavīmi tābhiṣṭupto vahatu havyamagniragnaye svāhā
verses.en: The first oblation that Atharvan offered, earliest sacrifice paid by Jatavedas, Even this I, foremost, with repeated worship, now offer unto thee. May Agni carry the sacrificer's present, Hail to Agni!

verses.sa:
आकूतिं देवीं सुभगां पुरो दधे चित्तस्य माता सुहवा नो अस्तु ।
यामाशामेमि केवली सा मे अस्तु विदेयमेनां मनसि प्रविष्टाम्॥
verses.tr: ākūtiṃ devīṃ subhagāṃ puro dadhe cittasya mātā suhavā no astu yāmāśāmemi kevalī sā me astu videyamenāṃ manasi praviṣṭām
verses.en: In fornt I set Intention, blessad Goddess. Mother of thought, may she be prompt to hear us. Mine, and mine only, be the hope I fashion! May I gain this that hath possessed my spirit,

verses.sa:
आकूत्या नो बृहस्पत आकूत्या न उपा गहि ।
अथो भगस्य नो धेह्यथो नः सुहवो भव॥
verses.tr: ākūtyā no bṛhaspata ākūtyā na upā gahi atho bhagasya no dhehyatho naḥ suhavo bhava
verses.en: With Purpose, O Prajapati, with Purpose come thou near to us, Bestow on us a share of luck, and so be swift to hear our call,

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिर्म आकूतिमाङ्गिरसः प्रति जानातु वाचमेताम्।
यस्य देवा देवताः संबभूवुः स सुप्रणीताः कामो अन्वेत्वस्मान्॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatirma ākūtimāṅgirasaḥ prati jānātu vācametām yasya devā devatāḥ saṃbabhūvuḥ sa supraṇītāḥ kāmo anvetvasmān
verses.en: Prajapati A ngirasa with favour regard this word and this my settled purpose! May he, whence Gods and Deities had being Kama attend us with his gentle guidance,

sections.label: A prayer for riches
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 5

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो राजा जगतश्चर्षणीनामधि क्षमि विषुरूपं यदस्ति ।
ततो ददाति दाशुषे वसूनि चोदद् राध उपस्तुतश्चिदर्वाक्॥
verses.tr: indro rājā jagataścarṣaṇīnāmadhi kṣami viṣurūpaṃ yadasti tato dadāti dāśuṣe vasūni codad rādha upastutaścidarvāk
verses.en: King of the living world and men is Indra, of all in varied form that earth containeth, Thence to the worshipper he giveth riches: may he enrich even us when we have praised him.

sections.label: The Purusha-Sukta, on the mystical Sacrifice of Purusha
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 6

verses.sa:
सहस्रबाहुः पुरुषः सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात्।
स भूमिं विश्वतो वृत्वात्यतिष्ठद् दशाङ्गुलम्॥
verses.tr: sahasrabāhuḥ puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt sa bhūmiṃ viśvato vṛtvātyatiṣṭhad daśāṅgulam
verses.en: Purusha hath a thousand arms, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet. On every side pervading earth he fills a space ten fingers wide.

verses.sa:
त्रिभिः पद्भिर्द्यामरोहत् पादस्येहाभवत् पुनः ।
तथा व्यऽक्रामद् विष्वङशनानशने अनु॥
verses.tr: tribhiḥ padbhirdyāmarohat pādasyehābhavat punaḥ tathā vya'krāmad viṣvaṅaśanānaśane anu
verses.en: He with three quarters rose to heaven: here reappeared a fourth of him, Thence he strode forth on every side to all that eats not and that eats,

verses.sa:
तावन्तो अस्य महिमानस्ततो ज्यायांश्च पूरुषः ।
पादोऽस्य विश्वा भूतानि त्रिपादस्यृतं दिवि॥
verses.tr: tāvanto asya mahimānastato jyāyāṃśca pūruṣaḥ pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni tripādasyṛtaṃ divi
verses.en: So mighty is his grandeur, yea, greater than this is Purusha. All creatures are one-fourth of him, three-fourths what dieth not in heaven,

verses.sa:
पुरुष एवेदं सर्वं यद् भूतं यच्च भाव्यम्।
उतामृतत्वस्येश्वरो यदन्येनाभवत् सह॥
verses.tr: puruṣa evedaṃ sarvaṃ yad bhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyam utāmṛtatvasyeśvaro yadanyenābhavat saha
verses.en: Purusha is in truth this All, what hath been and what yet shall be—Lord, too, of immortality—and what hath grown with somewhat else.

verses.sa:
यत् पुरुषं व्यदधुः कतिधा व्यऽकल्पयन्।
मुखं किमस्य किं बाहू किमूरू पादा उच्येते॥
verses.tr: yat puruṣaṃ vyadadhuḥ katidhā vya'kalpayan mukhaṃ kimasya kiṃ bāhū kimūrū pādā ucyete
verses.en: When they divided Purusha how many portions did t they make? What was his mouth? what were his arms? what are the names of thighs and feet?

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मणोऽस्य मुखमासीद् बाहू राजन्योऽभवत्।
मध्यं तदस्य यद् वैश्यः पद्भ्यां शूद्रो अजायत॥
verses.tr: brāhmaṇo'sya mukhamāsīd bāhū rājanyo'bhavat madhyaṃ tadasya yad vaiśyaḥ padbhyāṃ śūdro ajāyata
verses.en: The Brahman was his mouth, of both his arms was the Rajanya made, His waist became the Vaisya, from his feet the Sudra was produced,

verses.sa:
चन्द्रमा मनसो जातश्चक्षोः सूर्यो अजायत ।
मुखादिन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च प्राणाद् वायुरजायत॥
verses.tr: candramā manaso jātaścakṣoḥ sūryo ajāyata mukhādindraścāgniśca prāṇād vāyurajāyata
verses.en: The Moon was gendered from his mind, and from his eye the Sun had birth. Indra and Agni from his mouth were born and Vayu from his breath,

verses.sa:
नाभ्या आसीदन्तरिक्षं शीर्ष्णो द्यौः समवर्तत ।
पद्भ्यां भूमिर्दिशः श्रोत्रात् तथा लोकां अकल्पयन्॥
verses.tr: nābhyā āsīdantarikṣaṃ śīrṣṇo dyauḥ samavartata padbhyāṃ bhūmirdiśaḥ śrotrāt tathā lokāṃ akalpayan
verses.en: Forth form his navel come mid-air; the sky was fashioned from his head, Earth from his feet, and from his ear the regions, Thus they formed the worlds,

verses.sa:
विराडग्रे समभवद् विराजो अधि पूरुषः ।
स जातो अत्यरिच्यत पश्चाद् भूमिमथो पुरः॥
verses.tr: virāḍagre samabhavad virājo adhi pūruṣaḥ sa jāto atyaricyata paścād bhūmimatho puraḥ
verses.en: In the beginning rose Viraj: Purusha from Viraj was born. As soon as he was born he spread westward and eastward o'er the earth.

verses.sa:
यत् पुरुषेण हविषा देवा यज्ञमतन्वत ।
वसन्तो अस्यासीदाज्यं ग्रीष्म इध्मः शरद्धविः॥
verses.tr: yat puruṣeṇa haviṣā devā yajñamatanvata vasanto asyāsīdājyaṃ grīṣma idhmaḥ śaraddhaviḥ
verses.en: When Gods performed the sacrifice with Purusha as their offering Spring was the butter, summer was the fuel, autumn Was the gift.

verses.sa:
तं यज्ञं प्रावृषा प्रौक्षन् पुरुषं जातमग्रशः ।
तेन देवा अयजन्त साध्या वसवश्च ये॥
verses.tr: taṃ yajñaṃ prāvṛṣā praukṣan puruṣaṃ jātamagraśaḥ tena devā ayajanta sādhyā vasavaśca ye
verses.en: That sacrifice, first-born Purusha, they hallowed with the sprinkled Rains The Deities, the Sadhyas, all the Vasus sacrificed with him.

verses.sa:
तस्मादश्वा अजायन्त ये च के चोभयादतः ।
गावो ह जज्ञिरे तस्मात् तस्माज्जाता अजावयः॥
verses.tr: tasmādaśvā ajāyanta ye ca ke cobhayādataḥ gāvo ha jajñire tasmāt tasmājjātā ajāvayaḥ
verses.en: From it were horses born, from it all creatures with two rows of teeth. From it were generated kine, from it were goats and sheep produced.

verses.sa:
तस्माद् यज्ञात् सर्वहुत ऋचः सामानि जज्ञिरे ।
छन्दो ह जज्ञिरे तस्माद् यजुस्तस्मादजायत॥
verses.tr: tasmād yajñāt sarvahuta ṛcaḥ sāmāni jajñire chando ha jajñire tasmād yajustasmādajāyata
verses.en: From that great general sacrifice Richas and Sama hymns were born: Therefrom the metres were produced: the Yajus had its birth from it.

verses.sa:
तस्माद् यज्ञात् सर्वहुतः संभृतं पृषदाज्यऽम्।
पशूंस्तांश्चक्रे वायव्याऽनारण्या ग्राम्याश्च ये॥
verses.tr: tasmād yajñāt sarvahutaḥ saṃbhṛtaṃ pṛṣadājya'm paśūṃstāṃścakre vāyavyā'nāraṇyā grāmyāśca ye
verses.en: From that great general sacrifice the dripping fat was gathered up: It formed the creatures fleet as windj and animals both wild and tame.

verses.sa:
सप्तास्यासन् परिधयस्त्रिः सप्त समिधः कृताः ।
देवा यद् यज्ञं तन्वाना अबध्नन् पुरुषं पशुम्॥
verses.tr: saptāsyāsan paridhayastriḥ sapta samidhaḥ kṛtāḥ devā yad yajñaṃ tanvānā abadhnan puruṣaṃ paśum
verses.en: Seven fencing-logs had he, thrice seven layers of fuel were prepared. When, offering sacrifice, the Gods bound as their victim Purusha.

verses.sa:
मूर्ध्नो देवस्य बृहतो अंशवः सप्त सप्ततीः ।
राज्ञः सोमस्याजायन्त जातस्य पुरुषादधि॥
verses.tr: mūrdhno devasya bṛhato aṃśavaḥ sapta saptatīḥ rājñaḥ somasyājāyanta jātasya puruṣādadhi
verses.en: Forth from head of the high God seven-and-seventy bright beams Sprang into being, of the King Soma produced from Purusha,

sections.label: A hymn to the Sun and various heavenly bodies
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 7

verses.sa:
चित्राणि साकं दिवि रोचनानि सरीसृपाणि भुवने जवानि ।
तुर्मिशं सुमतिमिच्छमानो अहानि गीर्भिः सपर्यामि नाकम्॥
verses.tr: citrāṇi sākaṃ divi rocanāni sarīsṛpāṇi bhuvane javāni turmiśaṃ sumatimicchamāno ahāni gīrbhiḥ saparyāmi nākam
verses.en: The brilliant lights shining in heaven together, which through the world glide on with rapid motion, And Days, and Firmament with songs I worship, seeking the Twenty-eight-fold for its favour.

verses.sa:
सुहवमग्ने कृत्तिका रोहिणी चास्तु भद्रं मृगशिरः शमार्द्रा।
पुनर्वसू सूनृता चारु पुष्यो भानुराश्लेषा अयनं मघा मे॥
verses.tr: suhavamagne kṛttikā rohiṇī cāstu bhadraṃ mṛgaśiraḥ śamārdrā punarvasū sūnṛtā cāru puṣyo bhānurāśleṣā ayanaṃ maghā me
verses.en: Krittikas, Rohini be swift to hear me! Let Mrigasiras bless me, help me Ardra! Punarvasu and Sunrita, fair Pushya, the Sun, Asleslias, Magha lead me onward!

verses.sa:
पुण्यं पूर्वा फल्गुन्यौ चात्र हस्तश्चित्रा शिवा स्वाति सुखो मे अस्तु ।
राधे विशाखे सुहवानुराधा ज्येष्ठा सुनक्षत्रमरिष्ट मूलम्॥
verses.tr: puṇyaṃ pūrvā phalgunyau cātra hastaścitrā śivā svāti sukho me astu rādhe viśākhe suhavānurādhā jyeṣṭhā sunakṣatramariṣṭa mūlam
verses.en: My bliss be Svati and benignant Chitra, my right First Phalgunis and present Hasta. Radhas, Visakhas, gracious Anuradha, Jyeshtha and happy -starred uninjured Mila,

verses.sa:
अन्नं पूर्वा रासतां मे अषाढा ऊर्जं देव्युत्तरा आ वहन्तु ।
अभिजिन्मे रासतां पुण्यमेव श्रवणः श्रविष्ठाः कुर्वतां सुपुष्टिम्॥
verses.tr: annaṃ pūrvā rāsatāṃ me aṣāḍhā ūrjaṃ devyuttarā ā vahantu abhijinme rāsatāṃ puṇyameva śravaṇaḥ śraviṣṭhāḥ kurvatāṃ supuṣṭim
verses.en: Food shall the earlier Ashadhas grant me; let those that follow bring me strength and vigour; With virtuous merit Abhijit endow me! Sravana and Sravishthas make me prosper,

verses.sa:
आ मे महच्छतभिषग् वरीय आ मे द्वया प्रोष्ठपदा सुशर्म ।
आ रेवती चाश्वयुजौ भगं म आ मे रयिं भरण्य आ वहन्तु॥
verses.tr: ā me mahacchatabhiṣag varīya ā me dvayā proṣṭhapadā suśarma ā revatī cāśvayujau bhagaṃ ma ā me rayiṃ bharaṇya ā vahantu
verses.en: Satabhishak afford me ample freedom, and both the Proshthapadas guard me safely. Revati and the Asvayujas bring me luck, and the Bharanis abundant riches!

sections.label: A prayer to the Lunar Mansions and other Powers
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 8

verses.sa:
यानि नक्षत्राणि दिव्य१न्तरिक्षे अप्सु भूमौ यानि नगेषु दिक्षु।
प्रकल्पयंश्चन्द्रमा यान्येति सर्वाणि ममैतानि शिवानि सन्तु॥
verses.tr: yāni nakṣatrāṇi divya1ntarikṣe apsu bhūmau yāni nageṣu dikṣu prakalpayaṃścandramā yānyeti sarvāṇi mamaitāni śivāni santu
verses.en: Benign to me be all those Lunar Mansions to which the Moon as he moves on doth honour, All that are in the sky, the air, the waters, on earth, on mountains, in the heavenly regions.

verses.sa:
अष्टाविंशानि शिवानि शग्मानि सह योगं भजन्तु मे ।
योगं प्र पद्ये क्षेमं च क्षेमं प्र पद्ये योगं च नमोऽहोरात्राभ्यामस्तु॥
verses.tr: aṣṭāviṃśāni śivāni śagmāni saha yogaṃ bhajantu me yogaṃ pra padye kṣemaṃ ca kṣemaṃ pra padye yogaṃ ca namo'horātrābhyāmastu
verses.en: Propitious, mighty, let the eight-and-twenty together deal me out my share of profit, Profit and wealth be mine, and wealth and profit! To Day and Night be adoration rendered!

verses.sa:
स्वस्तितं मे सुप्रातः सुसायं सुदिवं सुमृगं सुशकुनं मे अस्तु ।
सुहवमग्ने स्वस्त्य१मर्त्यं गत्वा पुनरायाभिनन्दन्॥
verses.tr: svastitaṃ me suprātaḥ susāyaṃ sudivaṃ sumṛgaṃ suśakunaṃ me astu suhavamagne svastya1martyaṃ gatvā punarāyābhinandan
verses.en: Fair be my sunset, fair my morn and evening and day with lucky chase and happy omens; With blessing and success, immortal Agni, go to the mortal and return rejoicing. i

verses.sa:
अनुहवं परिहवं परिवादं परिक्षवम्।
सर्वैर्मे रिक्तकुम्भान् परा तान् सवितः सुव॥
verses.tr: anuhavaṃ parihavaṃ parivādaṃ parikṣavam sarvairme riktakumbhān parā tān savitaḥ suva
verses.en: Excitement and invoking cry, ill-omened sneezing and reproof, All sounds of empty pitchers send into the distance, Savitar!

verses.sa:
अपपापं परिक्षवं पुण्यं भक्षीमहि क्षवम्।
शिवा ते पाप नासिकां पुण्यगश्चाभि मेहताम्॥
verses.tr: apapāpaṃ parikṣavaṃ puṇyaṃ bhakṣīmahi kṣavam śivā te pāpa nāsikāṃ puṇyagaścābhi mehatām
verses.en: May we escape an evil sneeze, enjoy the sneeze of happy luck, And may our nostrils smelling what is pleasant pour forth fragrant scent,

verses.sa:
इमा या ब्रह्मणस्पते विषुचीर्वात ईरते ।
सध्रीचीरिन्द्र ताः कृत्वा मह्यं शिवतमास्कृधि॥
स्वस्ति नो अस्त्वभयं नो अस्तु नमोऽहोरत्राभ्यामस्तु॥
verses.tr: imā yā brahmaṇaspate viṣucīrvāta īrate sadhrīcīrindra tāḥ kṛtvā mahyaṃ śivatamāskṛdhi svasti no astvabhayaṃ no astu namo'horatrābhyāmastu
verses.en: These flames of Brahmanaspati borne to all quarters in the wind, Turn them all hither, Indra, and make them most gracious unto me.

sections.label: A prayer for general protection and prosperity
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 9

verses.sa:
शान्ता द्यौः शान्ता पृथिवी शान्तमिदमुर्व१न्तरिक्षम्।
शान्ता उदन्वतीरापः शान्ता नः सन्त्वोषधीः॥
verses.tr: śāntā dyauḥ śāntā pṛthivī śāntamidamurva1ntarikṣam śāntā udanvatīrāpaḥ śāntā naḥ santvoṣadhīḥ
verses.en: Gentle be heaven, gentle be earth, gentle this spacious atmosphere, Gentle be waters as they flow, gentle to us be plants and herbs!

verses.sa:
शान्तानि पूर्वरूपाणि शान्तं नो अस्तु कृताकृतम्।
शान्तं भूतं च भव्यं च सर्वमेव शमस्तु नः॥
verses.tr: śāntāni pūrvarūpāṇi śāntaṃ no astu kṛtākṛtam śāntaṃ bhūtaṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca sarvameva śamastu naḥ
verses.en: Gentle be signs of coming change, and that which is and is not done! Gentle be past and future, yea, let all be gracious unto us,

verses.sa:
इयं या परमेष्ठिनी वाग् देवी ब्रह्मसंशिता ।
ययैव ससृजे घोरं तयैव शान्तिरस्तु नः॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ yā parameṣṭhinī vāg devī brahmasaṃśitā yayaiva sasṛje ghoraṃ tayaiva śāntirastu naḥ
verses.en: Quickened by Prayer, this Goddess Vak who standeth in the highest place, By whom the awful spell was made, even through her to us be peace!

verses.sa:
इदं यत् परमेष्ठिनं मनो वां ब्रह्मसंशितम्।
येनैव ससृजे घोरं तेनैव शान्तिरस्तु नः॥
verses.tr: idaṃ yat parameṣṭhinaṃ mano vāṃ brahmasaṃśitam yenaiva sasṛje ghoraṃ tenaiva śāntirastu naḥ
verses.en: Or, made more keen by Prayer, this mind that standeth iu the highest place, Whereby the awful spell was made, even through this be peace to us!

verses.sa:
इमानि यानि पञ्चेन्द्रियाणि मनःषष्ठानि मे हृदि ब्रह्मणा संशितानि ।
यैरेव ससृजे घोरं तैरेव शान्तिरस्तु नः॥
verses.tr: imāni yāni pañcendriyāṇi manaḥṣaṣṭhāni me hṛdi brahmaṇā saṃśitāni yaireva sasṛje ghoraṃ taireva śāntirastu naḥ
verses.en: These five sense-organs with the mind as sixth, sharpened by Prayer, abiding in my heart, By which the awful spell Whs made, even by 'these be peace to us.

verses.sa:
शं नो मित्रः शं वरुणः शं विष्णुः शं प्रजापतिः ।
शं न इन्द्रो बृहस्पतिः शं नो भवत्वर्यमा॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no mitraḥ śaṃ varuṇaḥ śaṃ viṣṇuḥ śaṃ prajāpatiḥ śaṃ na indro bṛhaspatiḥ śaṃ no bhavatvaryamā
verses.en: Favour us Varuna, and Vishnu, and Prajapati! Gracious to us be Indra and Brihaspati and Aryaman.

verses.sa:
शं नो मित्रः शं वरुणः शं विवस्वांछमन्तकः ।
उत्पाताः पार्थिवान्तरिक्षाः शं नो दिविचरा ग्रहाः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no mitraḥ śaṃ varuṇaḥ śaṃ vivasvāṃchamantakaḥ utpātāḥ pārthivāntarikṣāḥ śaṃ no divicarā grahāḥ
verses.en: Favour us Mitra, Varuna, Vivasvan, and the Finisher, Portents on earth and in the air, and planets wandering in heaven!

verses.sa:
शं नो भूमिर्वेप्यमाना शमुल्का निर्हतं च यत्।
शं गावो लोहितक्षीराः शं भूमिरव तीर्यतीः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no bhūmirvepyamānā śamulkā nirhataṃ ca yat śaṃ gāvo lohitakṣīrāḥ śaṃ bhūmirava tīryatīḥ
verses.en: Gracious to us be trembling earth, gracious the flaming meteor stroke! Gracious be kine who yield red milk, gracious be earth when sinking down!

verses.sa:
नक्षत्रमुल्काभिहतं शमस्तु नः शं नोऽभिचाराः शमु सन्तु कृत्याः ।
शं नो निखाता वल्गाः शमुल्का देशोपसर्गाः शमु नो भवन्तु॥
verses.tr: nakṣatramulkābhihataṃ śamastu naḥ śaṃ no'bhicārāḥ śamu santu kṛtyāḥ śaṃ no nikhātā valgāḥ śamulkā deśopasargāḥ śamu no bhavantu
verses.en: Gracious be meteor-stricken constellation, gracious to us be magic spells and witchcraft! Gracious to us be buried charms, and gracious the meteors and the portents of the region!

verses.sa:
शं नो ग्रहाश्चान्द्रमसाः शमादित्यश्च राहुणा।
शं नो मृत्युर्धूमकेतुः शं रुद्रास्तिग्मतेजसः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no grahāścāndramasāḥ śamādityaśca rāhuṇā śaṃ no mṛtyurdhūmaketuḥ śaṃ rudrāstigmatejasaḥ
verses.en: Kind be the Powers who seize the Moon, with Rahu be Adityas kind! Favour us Death and Comet, and Rudras with penetrating might!

verses.sa:
शं रुद्राः शं वसवः शमादित्याः शमग्नयः ।
शं नो महर्षयो देवाः शं देवाः शं बृहस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ rudrāḥ śaṃ vasavaḥ śamādityāḥ śamagnayaḥ śaṃ no maharṣayo devāḥ śaṃ devāḥ śaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ
verses.en: Rudras and Vasus favour us, Adityas, Agnis favour us! Favour us mighty Rishis, Gods, Goddesses, and Brihaspati!

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म प्रजापतिर्धाता लोका वेदाः सप्तऋषयोऽग्नयः ।
तैर्मे कृतं स्वस्त्ययनमिन्द्रो मे शर्म यच्छतु ब्रह्मा मे शर्म यच्छतु ।
विश्वे मे देवाः शर्म यच्छन्तु सर्वे मे देवाः शर्म यच्छन्तु॥
verses.tr: brahma prajāpatirdhātā lokā vedāḥ saptaṛṣayo'gnayaḥ tairme kṛtaṃ svastyayanamindro me śarma yacchatu brahmā me śarma yacchatu viśve me devāḥ śarma yacchantu sarve me devāḥ śarma yacchantu
verses.en: Brahma, Dhatar, Prajapati, Worlds, Vedas, Agnis, Rishis Seven. All these have blessed my happy way. May Indra be my guardian, may Brahma protect and shelter me.

verses.sa:
यानि कानि चिच्छान्तानि लोके सप्तऋषयो विदुः ।
सर्वाणि शं भवन्तु मे शं मे अस्त्वभयं मे अस्तु॥
verses.tr: yāni kāni cicchāntāni loke saptaṛṣayo viduḥ sarvāṇi śaṃ bhavantu me śaṃ me astvabhayaṃ me astu
verses.en: May all the Gods protect me, may the Gods united shield me well. May all alleviations in the world which the Seven Rishis know Be kind and gracious unto me, Bliss and security be mine!

verses.sa:
पृथिवी शान्तिरन्तरिक्षं शान्तिर्द्यौः शान्तिरापः शान्तिरोषधयः शान्तिर्वनस्पतयः शान्तिर्विश्वे मे देवाः शान्तिः सर्वे मे देवाः शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिभिः ।
ताभिः शान्तिभिः सर्व शान्तिभिः शमयामोऽहं यदिह घोरं यदिह क्रूरं यदिह पापं तच्छान्तं तच्छिवं सर्वमेव शमस्तु नः॥
verses.tr: pṛthivī śāntirantarikṣaṃ śāntirdyauḥ śāntirāpaḥ śāntiroṣadhayaḥ śāntirvanaspatayaḥ śāntirviśve me devāḥ śāntiḥ sarve me devāḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntibhiḥ tābhiḥ śāntibhiḥ sarva śāntibhiḥ śamayāmo'haṃ yadiha ghoraṃ yadiha krūraṃ yadiha pāpaṃ tacchāntaṃ tacchivaṃ sarvameva śamastu naḥ
verses.en: Earth alleviation, air alleviation, heaven alleviation, waters alleviation, plants alleviation, trees alleviation, all Gods my alleviation, collective Gods my alleviation, alleviation by alleviations, By these alleviations, these universal alleviations, I allay all that is terrific here, all that is cruel, all that is wicked. This hath been calmed, this is now auspicious. Let all be favourable to us.

sections.label: A prayer for general protection and prosperity
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 10

verses.sa:
शं न इन्द्राग्नी भवतामवोभिः शं न इन्द्रावरुणा रातहव्या ।
शमिन्द्रासोमा सुविताय शं योः शं न इन्द्रापूषणा वाजसातौ॥
verses.tr: śaṃ na indrāgnī bhavatāmavobhiḥ śaṃ na indrāvaruṇā rātahavyā śamindrāsomā suvitāya śaṃ yoḥ śaṃ na indrāpūṣaṇā vājasātau
verses.en: Befriend us with their aids Indra and Agni, Indra and Varuna who receive oblations! Indra and Soma give health, wealth and comfort, Indra and Pushan be our strength in battle!

verses.sa:
शं नो भगः शमु नः शंसो अस्तु शं नः पुरंधिः शमु सन्तु रायः ।
शं नः सत्यस्य सुयमस्य शंसः शं नो अर्यमा पुरुजातो अस्तु॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no bhagaḥ śamu naḥ śaṃso astu śaṃ naḥ puraṃdhiḥ śamu santu rāyaḥ śaṃ naḥ satyasya suyamasya śaṃsaḥ śaṃ no aryamā purujāto astu
verses.en: Auspicious friends to us be Bhaga, Sansa, auspicious be Purandhi and all Riches, The blessing ofthe true and well-conducted and Aryaman in many forms apparent,

verses.sa:
शं नो धाता शमु धर्ता नो अस्तु शं न उरूची भवतु स्वधाभिः ।
शं रोदसी बृहती शं नो अद्रिः शं नो देवानां सुहवानि सन्तु॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no dhātā śamu dhartā no astu śaṃ na urūcī bhavatu svadhābhiḥ śaṃ rodasī bṛhatī śaṃ no adriḥ śaṃ no devānāṃ suhavāni santu
verses.en: Kind unto us be Maker and Sustainer and the far-reaching One with godlike nature. Auspicious unto us be Earth and Heaven, the Mountain and the Gods' fair invocations,

verses.sa:
शं नो अग्निर्ज्योतिरनीको अस्तु शं नो मित्रावरुणावश्विना शम्।
शं नः सुकृतां सुकृतानि सन्तु शं न इषिरो अभि वातु वातः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no agnirjyotiranīko astu śaṃ no mitrāvaruṇāvaśvinā śam śaṃ naḥ sukṛtāṃ sukṛtāni santu śaṃ na iṣiro abhi vātu vātaḥ
verses.en: Favour us Agni with his face of splendour, and Varuna and Mitra and the Asvins. Favour us noble actions of the pious; impetuous Vata blow on us with favour!

verses.sa:
शं नो द्यावापृथिवी पूर्वहूतौ शमन्तरिक्षं दृशये नो अस्तु ।
शं न ओषधीर्वनिनो भवन्तु शं नो रजसस्पतिरस्तु जिष्णुः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no dyāvāpṛthivī pūrvahūtau śamantarikṣaṃ dṛśaye no astu śaṃ na oṣadhīrvanino bhavantu śaṃ no rajasaspatirastu jiṣṇuḥ
verses.en: Early invoked may Heaven and Earth be friendly, and Air's mid-region good for us to look on, To us may herbs and forest trees be gracious, gracious the Lord victorious of the region.

verses.sa:
शं न इन्द्रो वसुभिर्देवो अस्तु शमादित्येभिर्वरुणः सुशंसः ।
शं नो रुद्रो रुद्रेभिर्जलाषः शं नस्त्वष्टा ग्नाभिरिह शृणोतु॥
verses.tr: śaṃ na indro vasubhirdevo astu śamādityebhirvaruṇaḥ suśaṃsaḥ śaṃ no rudro rudrebhirjalāṣaḥ śaṃ nastvaṣṭā gnābhiriha śṛṇotu
verses.en: Be the God Indra with the Vasus friendly, and with Adityas Varuna who blesseth. Kind with the Rudras be the healer Rudra, and with the Dames here Tvashtar kindly hear us,

verses.sa:
शं नः सोमो भवतु ब्रह्म शं नः शं नो ग्रावाणः शमु सन्तु यज्ञाः ।
शं नः स्वरूणा मितयो भवन्तु शं नः प्रस्वः१ शम्वस्तु वेदिः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ naḥ somo bhavatu brahma śaṃ naḥ śaṃ no grāvāṇaḥ śamu santu yajñāḥ śaṃ naḥ svarūṇā mitayo bhavantu śaṃ naḥ prasvaḥ1 śamvastu vediḥ
verses.en: Kind unto us be Soma and Devotions, kind be the Sacrifice and Stones for pressing. Kind be the fixing of the Sacred Pillars, kind be the tender Grass, and kind the Altar,

verses.sa:
शं नः सूर्य उरुचक्षा उदेतु शं नो भवन्तु प्रदिशश्चतस्रः ।
शं नः पर्वता ध्रुवयो भवन्तु शं नः सिन्धवः शमु सन्त्वापः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ naḥ sūrya urucakṣā udetu śaṃ no bhavantu pradiśaścatasraḥ śaṃ naḥ parvatā dhruvayo bhavantu śaṃ naḥ sindhavaḥ śamu santvāpaḥ
verses.en: May the far-seeing Sun rise up to bless us: be the four quarters of the heaven auspicious. Auspicious be the firmly-seated Mountains, auspicious be the Rivers and the Waters,

verses.sa:
शं नो अदितिर्भवतु व्रतेभिः शं नो भवन्तु मरुतः स्वर्काः ।
शं नो विष्णुः शमु पूषा नो अस्तु शं नो भवित्रं शम्वस्तु वायुः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no aditirbhavatu vratebhiḥ śaṃ no bhavantu marutaḥ svarkāḥ śaṃ no viṣṇuḥ śamu pūṣā no astu śaṃ no bhavitraṃ śamvastu vāyuḥ
verses.en: May Aditi through holy works be gracious, and may the Maruts, loud in song, be friendly, May Vishnu give felicity, and, Pushan, and Air that cherisheth our lives, and Vayu.

verses.sa:
शं नो देवः सविता त्रायमाणः शं नो भवन्तूषसो विभातीः ।
शं नः पर्जन्यो भवतु प्रजाभ्यः शं नः क्षेत्रस्य पतिरस्तु शंभुः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no devaḥ savitā trāyamāṇaḥ śaṃ no bhavantūṣaso vibhātīḥ śaṃ naḥ parjanyo bhavatu prajābhyaḥ śaṃ naḥ kṣetrasya patirastu śaṃbhuḥ
verses.en: Prosper us Savitar, the God who rescues, and let the radiant Mornings be propitious. Propitious to our children be Parjanya, kind to us be the field's benign Protector!

sections.label: A continuation of Hymn 10
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 11

verses.en: May the great Lords of Truth protect and aid us: blest to us be our horses and our cattle. Kind be the pious, skilful-handed Ribhus, kind be the Fathers at our invocations,
Kind to us be the Gods and Visve Devas, Sarasvati with Holy Thoughts be gracious, Friendly be they, the Liberal Ones, who seek us, yea, those who dwell in heaven, on earth, in waters,
May Aja-ekapad the God be gracious, gracious the Dragon of the Deep, and Ocean, Gracious be he, the swelling Child of Waters, gracious be Prisni who hath Gods to guard her,
So may the Rudras, Vasus, and Adityas accept the new hymn we now are making. ` May all the Holy Ones of earth and heaven, and the Cow's offspring hear our invocation.
Priests of the Gods, worthy of sacrifices, immortal, knowing Law, whom man must worship, May these to-day give us broad paths to travel, Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

sections.label: A prayer to Ushas or Dawn for wealth and long life
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 12

verses.sa:
उषा अप स्वसुस्तमः सं वर्तयति वर्तनिं सुजातता ।
अया वाजं देवहितं सनेम मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: uṣā apa svasustamaḥ saṃ vartayati vartaniṃ sujātatā ayā vājaṃ devahitaṃ sanema madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ
verses.en: Dawn drives away her sister's gloom, and through her excellence makes her retrace her path, Through her may we gain God-appointed treasure, and with brave sons be glad through hundred winters,

sections.label: A prayer for aid and victory in battle
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 13

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य बाहू स्थविरौ वृषाणौ चित्रा इमा वृषभौ पारयिष्णू।
तौ योक्षे प्रथमो योग आगते याभ्यां जितमसुराणां स्व१र्यत्॥
verses.tr: indrasya bāhū sthavirau vṛṣāṇau citrā imā vṛṣabhau pārayiṣṇū tau yokṣe prathamo yoga āgate yābhyāṃ jitamasurāṇāṃ sva1ryat
verses.en: These the two sturdy, manly arms of Indra, these that are wondrous, mighty, and successful—First, when the need hath come will I employ them by which the heaven of Asuras was conquered.

verses.sa:
आशुः शिशानो वृषभो न भीमो घनाघनः क्षोभणश्चर्षणीनाम्।
संक्रन्दनोऽनिमिष एकवीरः शतं सेना अजयत् साकमिन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: āśuḥ śiśāno vṛṣabho na bhīmo ghanāghanaḥ kṣobhaṇaścarṣaṇīnām saṃkrandano'nimiṣa ekavīraḥ śataṃ senā ajayat sākamindraḥ
verses.en: Swift, like a dread bull sharpening his weapons, rapidly striking, stirring up the people, Loud shouting, vigilant, the one sole Hero, Indra: subdued a hundred hosts together,

verses.sa:
संक्रन्दनेनानिमिषेण जिष्णुनाऽयोध्येन दुश्च्यवनेन धृष्णुना ।
तदिन्द्रेण जयत तत् सहध्वं युधो नर इषुहस्तेन वृष्णा॥
verses.tr: saṃkrandanenānimiṣeṇa jiṣṇunā'yodhyena duścyavanena dhṛṣṇunā tadindreṇa jayata tat sahadhvaṃ yudho nara iṣuhastena vṛṣṇā
verses.en: With him loud-roaring, ever watchful, victor, bold, hard to overthrow, whom none may vanquish, Indra the strong whose hand bears arrows, conquer, ye heroes now, now vanquish in the combat.

verses.sa:
स इषुहस्तैः स निषङ्गिभिर्वशी संस्रष्टा स युध इन्द्रो गणेन ।
संसृष्टजित् सोमपा बाहुशर्ध्यु१ग्रधन्वा प्रतिहिताभिरस्ता॥
verses.tr: sa iṣuhastaiḥ sa niṣaṅgibhirvaśī saṃsraṣṭā sa yudha indro gaṇena saṃsṛṣṭajit somapā bāhuśardhyu1gradhanvā pratihitābhirastā
verses.en: He rules with those who carry shafts and quivers, Indra who with his hand brings hosts together, Foe-conquering, strong of arm, the Soma-drinker, with mighty bow, shooting with well-laid arrows,

verses.sa:
बलविज्ञायः स्थविरः प्रवीरः सहस्वान् वाजी सहमान उग्रः ।
अभिवीरो अभिषत्वा सहोजिज्जैत्रमिन्द्र रथमा तिष्ठ गोविदम्॥
verses.tr: balavijñāyaḥ sthaviraḥ pravīraḥ sahasvān vājī sahamāna ugraḥ abhivīro abhiṣatvā sahojijjaitramindra rathamā tiṣṭha govidam
verses.en: Conspicuous by thy strength, firm, foremost fighter, mighty and fierce, victorious, all-subduing, O'ercoming might, excelling men and heroes, mount thy kine-winning conquering car, O Indra.

verses.sa:
इमं वीरमनु हर्षध्वमुग्रमिन्द्रं सखायो अनु सं रभध्वम्।
ग्रामजितं गोजितं वज्रबाहुं जयन्तमज्म प्रमृणन्तमोजसा॥
verses.tr: imaṃ vīramanu harṣadhvamugramindraṃ sakhāyo anu saṃ rabhadhvam grāmajitaṃ gojitaṃ vajrabāhuṃ jayantamajma pramṛṇantamojasā
verses.en: Troop-vanquisher, kine-winner, armed with thunder, who quells an army and with might destroys it,—Follow him, comrades! quit- yourselves like heroes, and like this Indra show your zeal and courage.

verses.sa:
अभि गोत्राणि सहसा गाहमानोऽदाय उग्रः शतमन्युरिन्द्रः ।
दुश्च्यवनः पृतनाषाडयोध्यो३ऽस्माकं सेना अवतु प्र युत्सु॥
verses.tr: abhi gotrāṇi sahasā gāhamāno'dāya ugraḥ śatamanyurindraḥ duścyavanaḥ pṛtanāṣāḍayodhyo3'smākaṃ senā avatu pra yutsu
verses.en: Piercing the cow-stalls with surpassing vigour, Indra the pitiless hero, wild with anger, Victor in fight, unshaken and resistless,—may he protect our armies in our battles,

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते परि दीया रथेन रक्षोहामित्राँ अपबाधमानः ।
प्रभञ्जंछत्रून् प्रमृणन्नमित्रानस्माकमेध्यविता तनूनाम्॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspate pari dīyā rathena rakṣohāmitrāṃ apabādhamānaḥ prabhañjaṃchatrūn pramṛṇannamitrānasmākamedhyavitā tanūnām
verses.en: Brihaspati, fly with thy chariot hither, slayer of demons, driving off our foemen, Be thou protector of our bodies, crushing our enemies, destroying those who hate us,

verses.sa:
इन्द्र एषां नेता बृहस्पतिर्दक्षिणा यज्ञः पुर एतु सोमः ।
देवसेनानामभिभञ्जतीनां जयन्तीनां मरुतो यन्तु मध्ये॥
verses.tr: indra eṣāṃ netā bṛhaspatirdakṣiṇā yajñaḥ pura etu somaḥ devasenānāmabhibhañjatīnāṃ jayantīnāṃ maruto yantu madhye
verses.en: Indra guide these! Brihaspati, the Guerdon, and Soma, and the Sacrifice precede them! And let the banded Maruts march in forefront of heavenly hosts that conquer and demolish.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य वृष्णो वरुणस्य राज्ञ आदित्यानां मरुतां शर्ध उग्रम्।
महामनसां भुवनच्यवानां घोषो देवानां जयतामुदस्थात्॥
verses.tr: indrasya vṛṣṇo varuṇasya rājña ādityānāṃ marutāṃ śardha ugram mahāmanasāṃ bhuvanacyavānāṃ ghoṣo devānāṃ jayatāmudasthāt
verses.en: Ours be the potent host of mighty Indra, King Varuna, and Maruts and Adityas. Uplifted is the shout of Gods who conquer, high-minded Gods who cause the world to tremble.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमिन्द्रः समृतेषु ध्वजेष्वस्माक या इषवस्ता जयन्तु ।
अस्माकं वीरा उत्तरे भवन्त्वस्मान् देवासोऽवता हवेषु॥
verses.tr: asmākamindraḥ samṛteṣu dhvajeṣvasmāka yā iṣavastā jayantu asmākaṃ vīrā uttare bhavantvasmān devāso'vatā haveṣu
verses.en: May Indra aid us when our flags are gathered: victorious be the arrows of our army. May our brave men of war prevail in battle, Ye Gods, protect us in the shouts of onset.

sections.label: A hymn after victory
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 14

verses.sa:
इदमुच्छ्रेयोऽवसानमागां शिवे मे द्यावापृथिवी अभूताम्।
असपत्नाः प्रदिशो मे भवन्तु न वै त्वा द्विष्मो अभयं नो अस्तु॥
verses.tr: idamucchreyo'vasānamāgāṃ śive me dyāvāpṛthivī abhūtām asapatnāḥ pradiśo me bhavantu na vai tvā dviṣmo abhayaṃ no astu
verses.en: I Have attained this goodliest place to rest in. Both Heaven and Earth have shown me grace and favour. Without a foe for me be all the regions! We hate thee not. May we have peace and safety. re

sections.label: A prayer for peace and security
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 15

verses.en: Indra, give us security from that whereof we art afraid. Help us, O Maghavan, let thy succour grant us this: drive foes and enemies afar.
We call on Indra, on the liberal giver: we will be prosperous in men and cattle. Let not the hosts of cruel fiends approach us. Drive off the Druhs to every side, O Indra,
Best, making household wealth increase, Indra our saviour, kills the foe, May he from outmost point be our protector, and from the centre and from west and eastward.
Lead us to ample room, O thou who knowest, to happiness, security, and sunlight, Strong, Indra, are the arms of thee the mighty: may we betake us to their lofty shelter.
May air's mid-region give us peace and safety, safety may both these, Heaven and Earth, afford us. Security be ours from west, from eastward, from north and south may we be free from danger.
Safety be ours from friend and from the unfriendly, safety from what we know and what we know not. Safety be ours by night and in the day-time! friendly to me fee all my hopes and wishes!
Hymn XVI

sections.label: A prayer for security from danger
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 16

verses.sa:
असपत्नं पुरस्तात् पश्चान्नो अभयं कृतम्।
सविता मा दक्षिणत उत्तरान्मा शचीपतिः॥
verses.tr: asapatnaṃ purastāt paścānno abhayaṃ kṛtam savitā mā dakṣiṇata uttarānmā śacīpatiḥ
verses.en: Peace hath been given us from the east, and from the west security. Savitar guard me from the south, and from the north the Lord of Might!

verses.sa:
दिवो मादित्या रक्षन्तु भूम्या रक्षन्त्वग्नयः ।
इन्द्राग्नी रक्षतां मा पुरस्तादश्विनावभितः शर्म यच्छताम्।
तिरश्चीनघ्न्या रक्षतु जातवेदा भूतकृतो मे सर्वतः सन्तु वर्म॥
verses.tr: divo mādityā rakṣantu bhūmyā rakṣantvagnayaḥ indrāgnī rakṣatāṃ mā purastādaśvināvabhitaḥ śarma yacchatām tiraścīnaghnyā rakṣatu jātavedā bhūtakṛto me sarvataḥ santu varma
verses.en: May the Adityas from the sky protect me, Agnis from the earth. May Indra-agni guard me from the eastward, on all sides may the Asvins give me shelter. May Jatavedas guard, sidelong, our cattle, Our shield on all sides be the World-creators!

sections.label: A prayer for protection from dangers in all directions
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 17

verses.sa:
अग्निर्मा पातु वसुभिः पुरस्तात् तस्मिन् क्रमे तस्मिंछ्रये तां पुरं प्रैमि ।
स मा रक्षतु स मा गोपायतु तस्मा आत्मानं परि ददे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: agnirmā pātu vasubhiḥ purastāt tasmin krame tasmiṃchraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā
verses.en: Agni from eastward guard me with the Vasus! To him I go, in him I rest: this fort I seek for refuge, May he protect me, may he be my guardian. I give my soul—All hail! into his keeping,

verses.sa:
वायुर्मान्तरिक्षेणैतस्या दिशः पातु तस्मिन् क्रमे तस्मिंछ्रये तां पुरं प्रैमि ।
स मा रक्षतु स मा गोपायतु तस्मा आत्मानं परि ददे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: vāyurmāntarikṣeṇaitasyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃchraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā
verses.en: Vayu with Air protect me from this region. To him I go, etc.

verses.sa:
सोमो मा रुद्रैर्दक्षिणाया दिशः पातु तस्मिन् क्रमे तस्मिंछ्रये तां पुरं प्रैमि ।
स मा रक्षतु स मा गोपायतु तस्मा आत्मानं परि ददे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: somo mā rudrairdakṣiṇāyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃchraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā
verses.en: May Soma from the south, with Rudras, guard me. To him, etc,

verses.sa:
वरुणो मादित्यैरेतस्या दिशः पातु तस्मिन् क्रमे तस्मिंछ्रये तां पुरं प्रैमि ।
स मा रक्षतु स मा गोपायतु तस्मा आत्मानं परि ददे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: varuṇo mādityairetasyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃchraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā
verses.en: Varuna with Adityas guard me from this region! t To him, etc.

verses.sa:
सूर्यो मा द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां प्रतीच्या दिशः पातु तस्मिन् क्रमे तस्मिंछ्रये तां पुरं प्रैमि ।
स मा रक्षतु स मा गोपायतु तस्मा आत्मानं परि ददे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: sūryo mā dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ pratīcyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃchraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā
verses.en: Surya with Earth and Heaven from the western region guard me well, To him, etc.

verses.sa:
आपो मौषधीमतीरेतस्या दिशः पान्तु तासु क्रमे तासु श्रये तां पुरं प्रैमि ।
ता मा रक्षन्तु ता मा गोपायन्तु ताभ्य आत्मानं परि ददे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: āpo mauṣadhīmatīretasyā diśaḥ pāntu tāsu krame tāsu śraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi tā mā rakṣantu tā mā gopāyantu tābhya ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā
verses.en: May Waters joined with Plants protect me from this region. To them I go, in them I rest: this fort I seek for refuge. May they protect me, may they be my guardians, I give my soul,—All hail!—into their keeping.

verses.sa:
विश्वकर्मा मा सप्तऋषिभिरुदीच्या दिशः पातु तस्मिन् क्रमे तस्मिंछ्रये तां पुरं प्रैमि ।
स मा रक्षतु स मा गोपायतु तस्मा आत्मानं परि ददे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: viśvakarmā mā saptaṛṣibhirudīcyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃchraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā
verses.en: May Visvakarman with the Seven Rishis be my protector from the northern region. To him, etc.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मा मरुत्वानेतस्या दिशः पातु तस्मिन् क्रमे तस्मिंछ्रये तां पुरं प्रैमि ।
स मा रक्षतु स मा गोपायतु तस्मा आत्मानं परि ददे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: indro mā marutvānetasyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃchraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā
verses.en: May Indra, Marut-girt, protect me from this region. To him, etc.

verses.sa:
प्रजापतिर्मा प्रजननवान्त्सह प्रतिष्ठाया ध्रुवाया दिशः पातु तस्मिन् क्रमे तस्मिंछ्रये तां पुरं प्रैमि ।
स मा रक्षतु स मा गोपायतु तस्मा आत्मानं परि ददे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: prajāpatirmā prajananavāntsaha pratiṣṭhāyā dhruvāyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃchraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā
verses.en: Prajapati, of generative power, with the Pratishtha save me from the nadir! To him, etc.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिर्मा विश्वैर्देवैरूर्ध्वाया दिशः पातु तस्मिन् क्रमे तस्मिंछ्रये तां पुरं प्रैमि ।
स मा रक्षतु स मा गोपायतु तस्मा आत्मानं परि ददे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatirmā viśvairdevairūrdhvāyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃchraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā
verses.en: Brihaspati, joined by the Visvedevas, protect me from the region of the zenith! To him, I go, in him I rest: this fort I seek for refuge. May he protect me, may he be my guardian. I give my soul—All hail!—into his keeping,

sections.label: A prayer for security and peace on all sides
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 18

verses.sa: अग्निं ते वसुवन्तमृच्छन्तु ।ये माघायवः प्राच्या दिशोऽभिदासात्॥
verses.tr: agniṃ te vasuvantamṛcchantu ye māghāyavaḥ prācyā diśo'bhidāsāt
verses.en: Let those who vex me from the eastern region, sinners, praise Agni followed by the Vasus.

verses.sa: वायुं ते३ऽन्तरिक्षवन्तमृछन्तु । ये माघायवः एतस्या दिशोऽभिदासात्॥
verses.tr: vāyuṃ te3'ntarikṣavantamṛchantu ye māghāyavaḥ etasyā diśo'bhidāsāt
verses.en: Let those who vex me from this quarter, sinners, praise Vayu compassed by the Air's mid-region,

verses.sa: सोमं ते रुद्रवन्तमृछन्तु । ये माघायवो दक्षिणाया दिशोऽभिदासात्॥
verses.tr: somaṃ te rudravantamṛchantu ye māghāyavo dakṣiṇāyā diśo'bhidāsāt
verses.en: Let those who vex me from the southern quarter, sinners, sing praise to Soma with the Rudras,

verses.sa: वरुणं त आदित्यवन्तमृच्छन्तु ।ये माघायव एतस्या दिशोऽभिदासात्॥
verses.tr: varuṇaṃ ta ādityavantamṛcchantu ye māghāyava etasyā diśo'bhidāsāt
verses.en: Let those who vex me from this quarter, sinners, praise Varuna connected with Adityas.

verses.sa: सूर्यं ते द्यावापृथिवीवन्तमृच्छन्तु । ये माघायव प्रतीच्याः दिशोऽभिदासात्॥
verses.tr: sūryaṃ te dyāvāpṛthivīvantamṛcchantu ye māghāyava pratīcyāḥ diśo'bhidāsāt
verses.en: Let those who vex me from the western quarter, sinners, praise Surya linked with Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa: अपस्त ओषधीमतीरृछन्तु । ये माघायव एतस्या दिशोऽभिदासात्॥
verses.tr: apasta oṣadhīmatīrṛchantu ye māghāyava etasyā diśo'bhidāsāt
verses.en: Let those who vex me from this quarter, sinners give praise to plants' associates the Waters,

verses.sa: विश्वकर्माणं ते सप्तऋषिवन्तमृच्छन्तु । ये माघायव उदीच्या दिशोऽभिदासात्॥
verses.tr: viśvakarmāṇaṃ te saptaṛṣivantamṛcchantu ye māghāyava udīcyā diśo'bhidāsāt
verses.en: Let those who from the north side vex me, sinners, praise Visvakarman with the Seven Rishis.

verses.sa: इन्द्रं ते मरुत्वन्तमृच्छन्तु । ये माघायव एतस्या दिशोऽभिदासात्॥
verses.tr: indraṃ te marutvantamṛcchantu ye māghāyava etasyā diśo'bhidāsāt
verses.en: Let those who vex me from this quarter, sinners, praise Indra with the Marut host about him.

verses.sa: प्रजापतिं ते प्रजननवन्तमृच्छन्तु । ये माघायवो ध्रुवाया दिशोऽभिदासात्॥
verses.tr: prajāpatiṃ te prajananavantamṛcchantu ye māghāyavo dhruvāyā diśo'bhidāsāt
verses.en: Let those who vex me from the nadir, sinners, extol Prajapati of genial power,

verses.sa: बृहस्पतिं ते विश्वदेववन्तमृच्छन्तु । ये माघायव ऊर्ध्वाया दिशोऽभिदासात्॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatiṃ te viśvadevavantamṛcchantu ye māghāyava ūrdhvāyā diśo'bhidāsāt
verses.en: Let those who vex me from the zenith, sinners, extol Brihaspati with the Visve Devas.

sections.label: A hymn recommending the protection of various Gods
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 19

verses.sa:
मित्रः पृथिव्योदक्रामत् तां पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु॥
verses.tr: mitraḥ pṛthivyodakrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu
verses.en: Mitra arose with Earth. To that fort I lead you: enter it, occupy it, Let it give you protection and defence. l

verses.sa:
वायुरन्तरिक्षेणोदक्रामत् तां पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु॥
verses.tr: vāyurantarikṣeṇodakrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu
verses.en: Vayu arose with Air. To that fort, etc,

verses.sa:
सूर्यो दिवोदक्रामत् तां पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु॥
verses.tr: sūryo divodakrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu
verses.en: Surya arose with Heaven, To that fort, etc,

verses.sa:
चन्द्रमा नक्षत्रैरुदक्रामत् तां पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु॥
verses.tr: candramā nakṣatrairudakrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu
verses.en: Chandramas arose with the Constellation. To that fort, etc.

verses.sa:
सोम ओषधीभिरुदक्रामत् तां पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु॥
verses.tr: soma oṣadhībhirudakrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu
verses.en: Sacrifice arose with Priestly Fees, To that fort, etc.

verses.sa:
यज्ञो दक्षिणाभिरुदक्रामत् तां पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु॥
verses.tr: yajño dakṣiṇābhirudakrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu
verses.en: Ocean arose with the Rivers, To that fort, etc.

verses.sa:
समुद्रो नदीभिरुदक्रामत् तां पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु॥
verses.tr: samudro nadībhirudakrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu
verses.en: Brahma arose with the Brahmacharis, To that fort, etc.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म ब्रह्मचारिभिरुदक्रामत् पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु॥
verses.tr: brahma brahmacāribhirudakrāmat puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu
verses.en: Indra arose with Manly Might, To that fort, etc,

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो वीर्ये३णोदक्रामत् तां पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु॥
verses.tr: indro vīrye3ṇodakrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu
verses.en: The Gods arose with Immortality, To that fort, etc.

verses.sa:
देवा अमृतेनोदक्रामंस्तां पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु॥
प्रजापतिः प्रजाभिरुदक्रामत् तां पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु॥
verses.tr: devā amṛtenodakrāmaṃstāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu prajāpatiḥ prajābhirudakrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu
verses.en: Prajapati arose with Creatures. To that fort I lead you: enter it, occupy it give you protection and defence.

sections.label: A prayer for protection from death and misfortune
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 20

verses.sa:
अप न्यधुः पौरुषेयं वधं यमिन्द्राग्नी धाता सविता बृहस्पतिः ।
सोमो राजा वरुणो अश्विना यमः पूषास्मान् परि पातु मृत्योः॥
verses.tr: apa nyadhuḥ pauruṣeyaṃ vadhaṃ yamindrāgnī dhātā savitā bṛhaspatiḥ somo rājā varuṇo aśvinā yamaḥ pūṣāsmān pari pātu mṛtyoḥ
verses.en: May Soma, Varuna the King, both Asvins, Yama and Pushan guard us well from Mrityu—Death caused by men, which Indra-agni, Dhatar, Brihaspati and Savitar appointed.

verses.sa:
यानि चकार भुवनस्य यस्पतिः प्रजापतिर्मातरिश्वा प्रजाभ्यः ।
प्रदिशो यानि वसते दिशश्च तानि मे वर्माणि बहुलानि सन्तु॥
verses.tr: yāni cakāra bhuvanasya yaspatiḥ prajāpatirmātariśvā prajābhyaḥ pradiśo yāni vasate diśaśca tāni me varmāṇi bahulāni santu
verses.en: All that the World's Lord made, all that for creatures Prajapati and Matarisvan fashioned, All things within the quarters and their spaces, let all these he my manifold defences.

verses.sa:
यत् ते तनूष्वनह्यन्त देवा द्युराजयो देहिनः ।
इन्द्रो यच्चक्रे वर्म तदस्मान् पातु विश्वतः॥
verses.tr: yat te tanūṣvanahyanta devā dyurājayo dehinaḥ indro yaccakre varma tadasmān pātu viśvataḥ
verses.en: That which the Gods bound on them when, they battled for their royal sway, What Indra made his shield, may that protect us well on every side.

verses.sa:
वर्म मे द्यावापृथिवी वर्माहर्वर्म सूर्यः ।
वर्म मे विश्वे देवाः क्रन् मा मा प्रापत् प्रतीचिका॥
verses.tr: varma me dyāvāpṛthivī varmāharvarma sūryaḥ varma me viśve devāḥ kran mā mā prāpat pratīcikā
verses.en: My shield is Heaven and Earth, my shield is the bright Day, my shield the Sun. The Visve Devas made my shield, Let not misfortune fall on me.

sections.label: A prose hymn of homage to various portions of the Atharva-veda
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 22

verses.sa: आङ्गिरसानामाद्यैः पञ्चानुवाकैः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: āṅgirasānāmādyaiḥ pañcānuvākaiḥ svāhā
verses.en: With the first five chapters of the Angirases, Hail! t

verses.sa: षष्ठाय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ṣaṣṭhāya svāhā
verses.en: To the sixth, Hail!

verses.sa: सप्तमाष्टमाभ्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: saptamāṣṭamābhyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: To the seventh and eighth, Hail!

verses.sa: नीलनखेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: nīlanakhebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: To the black-clawed ones, Hail! A prayer for protection from Death and misfortune, That which the Gods bound on them: an amulet or all-powerful

verses.sa: हरितेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: haritebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: To the golden-hued ones, Hail!

verses.sa: क्षुद्रेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: kṣudrebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: To the small ones, Hail!

verses.sa: पर्यायिकेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: paryāyikebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: To those composed in strophes, Hail!

verses.sa: प्रथमेभ्यः शङ्खेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: prathamebhyaḥ śaṅkhebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: To the first stalls, Hail!

verses.sa: द्वितीयेभ्यः शङ्खेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: dvitīyebhyaḥ śaṅkhebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: To the second shells, Hail!

verses.sa: तृतीयेभ्यः शङ्खेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: tṛtīyebhyaḥ śaṅkhebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: To the third shells, Hail!

verses.sa:
उपोत्तमेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
उत्तमेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: upottamebhyaḥ svāhā uttamebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: To the penultimates, Hail! I To the last ones, Hail!

verses.sa: उत्तरेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: uttarebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: To the latter ones, Hail!

verses.sa: ऋषिभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ṛṣibhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: To the Rishis, Hail!

verses.sa: शिखिभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: śikhibhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: To those with hair in tufts, Hail!

verses.sa: गणेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: gaṇebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: To the Ganas, Hail!

verses.sa: महागणेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: mahāgaṇebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: To the great Ganas, Hail!

verses.sa: सर्वेभ्योऽङ्गिरोभ्यो विदगणेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: sarvebhyo'ṅgirobhyo vidagaṇebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: To all the Vidagana Angirases, Hail!

verses.sa: पृथक्सहस्राभ्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: pṛthaksahasrābhyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: To those two with separate thousands, Hail!

verses.sa: ब्रह्मणे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: brahmaṇe svāhā
verses.en: To Brahma, Hail!

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मज्येष्ठा संभृता विर्याऽणि ब्रह्माग्रे ज्येष्ठं दिवमा ततान ।
भूतानां ब्रह्मा प्रथमोत जज्ञे तेनार्हति ब्रह्मणा स्पर्धितुं कः॥
verses.tr: brahmajyeṣṭhā saṃbhṛtā viryā'ṇi brahmāgre jyeṣṭhaṃ divamā tatāna bhūtānāṃ brahmā prathamota jajñe tenārhati brahmaṇā spardhituṃ kaḥ
verses.en: Collected manly powers are topped by Brahma. Brahma at first spread out the loftiest heaven. Brahma was born first of all things existing. Who then is meet to be that Brahma's rival?

sections.name: Book 19, hymn 23

verses.sa: आथर्वणानां चतुरृचेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ātharvaṇānāṃ caturṛcebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Hail to the four-verse strophes of the Atharvans!

verses.sa: पञ्चर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: pañcarcebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Hail to the five-versed!

verses.sa:
षळृचेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
सप्तर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ṣaḻṛcebhyaḥ svāhā saptarcebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Hail to the six-versed! t Hail to the seven-versed!

verses.sa: अष्टर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: aṣṭarcebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Hail to the eight-versed!

verses.sa: नवर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: navarcebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Hail to the nine-versed!

verses.sa: दशर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: daśarcebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Hail to the ten-versed!

verses.sa: एकादशर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ekādaśarcebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Hail to the eleven-versed!

verses.sa: द्वादशर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: dvādaśarcebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Hail to the twelve-versed!

verses.sa:
त्रयोदशर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
चतुर्दशर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: trayodaśarcebhyaḥ svāhā caturdaśarcebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Hail to the thirteen-versed! I Hail to the fourteen-versed!

verses.sa: पञ्चदशर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: pañcadaśarcebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Hail to the fifteen-versed!

verses.sa:
षोडशर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
सप्तदशर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
अष्टादशर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा॥

verses.en: Hail to the sixteen-versed! I Hail to the seven teen- versed f Hail to the eighteen-versed! I Hail, nineteen!

verses.sa: विंशतिः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: viṃśatiḥ svāhā

verses.sa: महत्काण्डाय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: mahatkāṇḍāya svāhā
verses.en: Hail to the Great Section!

verses.sa: तृचेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: tṛcebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Hail to the triplets!

verses.sa:
एकर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
क्षुद्रेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ekarcebhyaḥ svāhā kṣudrebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Hail to the single-versed hymns! I Hail to the little ones!

verses.sa: एकानृचेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ekānṛcebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Hail to the single-non- Rich-versed ones!

verses.sa: रोहितेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: rohitebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Hail to the Rohita!

verses.sa: सूर्याभ्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: sūryābhyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: Hail to the two Surya hymns!

verses.sa: व्रात्याभ्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: vrātyābhyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: Hail to tho two Vratya hymns!

verses.sa: प्राजापत्याभ्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: prājāpatyābhyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: Hail to the two Prajapati hymns!

verses.sa: विषासह्यै स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: viṣāsahyai svāhā
verses.en: Hail to the hymn of victory!

verses.sa: मङ्गलिकेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: maṅgalikebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Hail to the hymns for happiness!

verses.sa: ब्रह्मणे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: brahmaṇe svāhā
verses.en: Hail to Brahma!

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मज्येष्ठा संभृता वीर्याऽणि ब्रह्माग्रे ज्येष्ठं दिवमा ततान ।
भूतानां ब्रह्मा प्रथमोत जज्ञे तेनार्हति ब्रह्मणा स्पर्धितुं कः॥
verses.tr: brahmajyeṣṭhā saṃbhṛtā vīryā'ṇi brahmāgre jyeṣṭhaṃ divamā tatāna bhūtānāṃ brahmā prathamota jajñe tenārhati brahmaṇā spardhituṃ kaḥ
verses.en: Collected manly powers are topped by 'Brahma. Brahma at first spread out the loftiest heaven, Brahma was born first of all things existing. Who then is fit to be this Brahma's rival?

sections.label: A benediction on a newly elected King
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 24

verses.sa:
येन देवं सवितारं परि देवा अधारयन्।
तेनेमं ब्रह्मणस्पते परि राष्ट्राय धत्तन॥
verses.tr: yena devaṃ savitāraṃ pari devā adhārayan tenemaṃ brahmaṇaspate pari rāṣṭrāya dhattana
verses.en: Do ye, O Brahmanaspati, invest for royal sway this man With that wherewith the Deities invested Savitar the God,

verses.sa:
परीममिन्द्रमायुषे महे क्षत्राय धत्तन ।
यथैनं जरसे नयां ज्योक् क्षत्रेऽधि जागरत्॥
verses.tr: parīmamindramāyuṣe mahe kṣatrāya dhattana yathainaṃ jarase nayāṃ jyok kṣatre'dhi jāgarat
verses.en: Invest this Indra for long life, invest him for great princely power, That I may lead him on to eld, that he may watch his princedom long.

verses.sa:
परीमं सोममायुषे महे श्रोत्राय धत्तन ।
यथैनं जरसे नयां ज्योक् क्षत्रेऽधि जागरत्॥
verses.tr: parīmaṃ somamāyuṣe mahe śrotrāya dhattana yathainaṃ jarase nayāṃ jyok kṣatre'dhi jāgarat
verses.en: Invest this Soma for long life, invest him for great hearing power, That I may lead him on to eld, that he may watch o'er hearing long,

verses.sa:
परि धत्त धत्त नो वर्चसेमं जरामृत्युं कृणुत दीर्घमायुः ।
बृहस्पतिः प्रायच्छद् वास एतत् सोमाय राज्ञे परिधातवा उ॥
verses.tr: pari dhatta dhatta no varcasemaṃ jarāmṛtyuṃ kṛṇuta dīrghamāyuḥ bṛhaspatiḥ prāyacchad vāsa etat somāya rājñe paridhātavā u
verses.en: For us, surround him, cover him with splendour, give him long life, and death when age removes him, This garment bath Brihaspati presented to Soma, to the King, to wrap about him.

verses.sa:
जरां सु गच्छ परि धत्स्व वासो भवा गृष्टीनामभिशस्तिपा उ ।
शतं च जीव शरदः पुरूची रायश्च पोषमुपसंव्ययस्व॥
verses.tr: jarāṃ su gaccha pari dhatsva vāso bhavā gṛṣṭīnāmabhiśastipā u śataṃ ca jīva śaradaḥ purūcī rāyaśca poṣamupasaṃvyayasva
verses.en: Advance to good old age: endue the mantle, Be thou our heifers' guard from imprecation, Live thou a hundred full and plenteous autumns, and wrap thee in prosp erity of riches.

verses.sa:
परीदं वासो अधिथाः स्वस्तयेऽभूर्वापीनामभिशस्तिपा उ ।
शतं च जीव शरदः पुरूचीर्वसूनि चारुर्वि भजासि जीवन्॥
verses.tr: parīdaṃ vāso adhithāḥ svastaye'bhūrvāpīnāmabhiśastipā u śataṃ ca jīva śaradaḥ purūcīrvasūni cārurvi bhajāsi jīvan
verses.en: Thou for weal hast clothed thee in this garment: thou hast become o ur cows' sure guard from curses. Live thou a hundred full and plenteous autumns: thou living, fair thyself, shalt deal forth treasures,

verses.sa:
योगेयोगे तवस्तरं वाजेवाजे हवामहे ।
सखाय इन्द्रमूतये॥
verses.tr: yogeyoge tavastaraṃ vājevāje havāmahe sakhāya indramūtaye
verses.en: In every need, in every fray we call, as friends, to succour us, Indra the mightiest of all,

verses.sa:
हिरण्यवर्णो अजरः सुवीरो जरामृत्युः प्रजया सं विशस्व ।
तदग्निराह तदु सोम आह बृहस्पतिः सविता तदिन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyavarṇo ajaraḥ suvīro jarāmṛtyuḥ prajayā saṃ viśasva tadagnirāha tadu soma āha bṛhaspatiḥ savitā tadindraḥ
verses.en: Gold-coloured, un decaying, blest with heroes, dwell, dying in old age, with children round thee. This is the spoken word of Agni, Soma, Brihaspati and Savitar. and Indra,

sections.label: A charm to be used when a young ox is first yoked
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 25

verses.sa:
अश्रान्तस्य त्वा मनसा युनज्मि प्रथमस्य च ।
उत्कूलमुद्वहो भवोदुह्य प्रति धावतात्॥
verses.tr: aśrāntasya tvā manasā yunajmi prathamasya ca utkūlamudvaho bhavoduhya prati dhāvatāt
verses.en: I Yoke thee with the mind of one unwearied still and first of all. Be thou a bearer up the hill: run hither bearing up thy load,

sections.label: A hymn accompanying investiture with an amulet of Sold
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 26

verses.sa:
अग्नेः प्रजातं परि यद्धिरण्यममृतं दध्रे अधि मर्त्येषु ।
य एनद् वेद स इदेनमर्हति जरामृत्युर्भवति यो बिभर्ति॥
verses.tr: agneḥ prajātaṃ pari yaddhiraṇyamamṛtaṃ dadhre adhi martyeṣu ya enad veda sa idenamarhati jarāmṛtyurbhavati yo bibharti
verses.en: Gold that was born from Fire and is immortal hath been deposited with mortal creatures. He who knows this deserves to own this jewel, and in extreme old age dies he who wears it,

verses.sa:
यद्धिरण्यं सूर्येण सुवर्णं प्रजावन्तो मनवः पूर्व ईषिरे।
तत् त्वा चन्द्रं वर्चसा सं सृजत्यायुष्मान् भवति यो बिभर्ति॥
verses.tr: yaddhiraṇyaṃ sūryeṇa suvarṇaṃ prajāvanto manavaḥ pūrva īṣire tat tvā candraṃ varcasā saṃ sṛjatyāyuṣmān bhavati yo bibharti
verses.en: The men of ancient time with children round them longed for this Gold, bright with the Sun's own colour, This shall endow thee, as it shines, with splendour, and long shall be the life of him who wears it.

verses.sa:
आयुषे त्वा वर्चसे त्वौजसे च बलाय च ।
यथा हिरण्यतेजसा विभासासि जनाँ अनु॥
verses.tr: āyuṣe tvā varcase tvaujase ca balāya ca yathā hiraṇyatejasā vibhāsāsi janāṃ anu
verses.en: Long life and splendour let it bring, bring energy and strength to thee That thou mayst shine among the folk with all the brightness of the Gold.

verses.sa:
यद् वेद राजा वरुणो वेद देवो बृहस्पतिः ।
इन्द्रो यद् वृत्रहा वेद तत् त आयुष्यं भुवत् तत् ते वर्चस्यं भुवत्॥
verses.tr: yad veda rājā varuṇo veda devo bṛhaspatiḥ indro yad vṛtrahā veda tat ta āyuṣyaṃ bhuvat tat te varcasyaṃ bhuvat
verses.en: What Varuna the King knows well, and what the God Brihaspati, And Indra, Slayer of the Foe, may that bestow long life on thee, may that increase thy splendid strength,

sections.label: A benedictory hymn
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 27

verses.en: Let the Bull guard thee with the kine, the Stallion with the fleet-foot steeds, Let Vayu keep thee safe with prayer, and Indra with his mighty power.
Let Soma guard thee with the plants, Surya protect thee with the stars; With breath let Wind protect thee, and the Moon, foe-slayer, with the mouths.

Three are the earths, they say, and three the heavens, three are the atmospheres, and four the oceans, Threefold the hymn of praise, thereefold the Waters, Let these with triple song and triplets guard thee,
Three vaults of heaven, and three seas, three bright, three stationary ones, Three Matarisvans, and three suns, protectors, I arrange for thee,
Increasing thee with butter I, Agni! with fatness sprinkle thee, Let not magicians harm the life of Agni or of Moon or Sun.
Let not magicians mar your heat, your vital or diffusive breath. Brilliant and all-possessing Gods, run ye your course: with Godlike power.
Fire they endow with vital breathy Wind is compact, with vital breath: With vital breath the Gods produced the Sun whose face turn every way.
Live with the Life-creators' life. Die not, live on to lengthened age. Live with the breath of men with souls. Submit not to the power of Death.
The secret treasure of the Gods which Indra, by pathways travelled by the Gods, discovered, That gold the Waters with the triplets guarded. May they keep thee with threefold hymn and triplets.
With friendly thoughts the Deities, three-and-thirty, and three great Powers preserved it in the Waters. He made heroic powers with the gold that lies upon this Moon,
O ye eleven Gods who are in heaven, accept this sacrifice.
O ye eleven Gods who are in air, accept this sacrifice.
O ye eleven Gods who are on earth, accept this sacrifice,

sections.label: A charm for the destruction of enemies
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 28

verses.sa:
इमं बध्नामि ते मणिं दीर्घायुत्वाय तेजसे ।
दर्भं सपत्नदम्भनं द्विषतस्तपनं हृदः॥
verses.tr: imaṃ badhnāmi te maṇiṃ dīrghāyutvāya tejase darbhaṃ sapatnadambhanaṃ dviṣatastapanaṃ hṛdaḥ
verses.en: On thee I bind this Amulet for lengthened life and brilliancy, The rival-quelling Darbha grass that burns the spirit of a foe. f

verses.sa:
द्विषतस्तापयन् हृदः शत्रूणां तापयन् मनः ।
दुर्हार्दः सर्वांस्त्वं दर्भ घर्म इवाभिन्त्संतापयन्॥
verses.tr: dviṣatastāpayan hṛdaḥ śatrūṇāṃ tāpayan manaḥ durhārdaḥ sarvāṃstvaṃ darbha gharma ivābhintsaṃtāpayan
verses.en: Burning the spirit of the foe, vexing the heart of enemies, Darbha, on every side, like heat, inflame all evil-hearted men,

verses.sa:
घर्म इवाभितपन् दर्भ द्विषतो नितपन् मणे ।
हृदः सपत्नानां भिन्द्धीन्द्र इव विरुजं बलम्॥
verses.tr: gharma ivābhitapan darbha dviṣato nitapan maṇe hṛdaḥ sapatnānāṃ bhinddhīndra iva virujaṃ balam
verses.en: O Darbha, burning round like heat, consuming foes, O Amulet, Like Indra rending Vala cleave mine adversaries' hearts in twain.

verses.sa:
भिन्द्धि दर्भ सपत्नानां हृदयः द्विषतां मणे ।
उद्यन्त्वचमिव भूम्याः शिर एषा वि पातय॥
verses.tr: bhinddhi darbha sapatnānāṃ hṛdayaḥ dviṣatāṃ maṇe udyantvacamiva bhūmyāḥ śira eṣā vi pātaya
verses.en: Cleave through, O Darbha, Amulet, my foes', mine adversaries' heart. Rise thou and batter down their heads like growth that covereth the earth.

verses.sa:
भिन्द्धि दर्भ सपत्नान्मे भिन्द्धि मे पृतनायतः ।
भिन्द्धि मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो भिन्द्धि मे द्विषतो मणे॥
verses.tr: bhinddhi darbha sapatnānme bhinddhi me pṛtanāyataḥ bhinddhi me sarvān durhārdo bhinddhi me dviṣato maṇe
verses.en: Cleave thou my rivals, Darbha, cleave the men who fain would fight with me, Cleave all who wish me evil, cleave the men who hate me, Amulet!

verses.sa:
छिन्द्धि दर्भ सपत्नान् मे छिन्द्धि मे पृतनायतः ।
छिन्द्धि मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो छिन्द्धि मे द्विषतो मणे॥
verses.tr: chinddhi darbha sapatnān me chinddhi me pṛtanāyataḥ chinddhi me sarvān durhārdo chinddhi me dviṣato maṇe
verses.en: Wound thou, my rivals, Darbha, etc, (as in substituting l wound ' for cleave.)

verses.sa:
वृश्च दर्भ सपत्नान्मे वृश्च मे पृतनायतः ।
वृश्च मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो वृश्च मे द्विषतो मणे॥
verses.tr: vṛśca darbha sapatnānme vṛśca me pṛtanāyataḥ vṛśca me sarvān durhārdo vṛśca me dviṣato maṇe
verses.en: Tear thou my rivals, Darbha, etc,

verses.sa:
कृन्त दर्भ सपत्नान् मे कृन्त मे पृतनायतः ।
कृन्त मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो कृन्त मे द्विषतो मणे॥
verses.tr: kṛnta darbha sapatnān me kṛnta me pṛtanāyataḥ kṛnta me sarvān durhārdo kṛnta me dviṣato maṇe
verses.en: Hew thou my rivals, Darbha, etc.

verses.sa:
पिंश दर्भ सपत्नान्मे पिंश मे पृतनायतः ।
पिंश मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो पिंश मे द्विषतो मणे॥
verses.tr: piṃśa darbha sapatnānme piṃśa me pṛtanāyataḥ piṃśa me sarvān durhārdo piṃśa me dviṣato maṇe
verses.en: Carve thou my rivals, Darbha, etc.

verses.sa:
विध्य दर्भ सपत्नान् मे विध्य मे पृतनायतः ।
विध्य मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो विध्य मे द्विषतो मणे॥
verses.tr: vidhya darbha sapatnān me vidhya me pṛtanāyataḥ vidhya me sarvān durhārdo vidhya me dviṣato maṇe
verses.en: Pierce thou my rivals, Darbha, pierce the men who fain would fight with me. Pierce those who wish me evil, pierce the men who hate me, Amulet!

sections.label: A continuation of Hymn 28
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 29

verses.sa:
निक्ष दर्भ सपत्नान् मे निक्ष मे पृतनायतः ।
निक्ष मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो निक्ष मे द्विषतो मणे॥
verses.tr: nikṣa darbha sapatnān me nikṣa me pṛtanāyataḥ nikṣa me sarvān durhārdo nikṣa me dviṣato maṇe
verses.en: Prerog thou my rivals, Darbha, pierce the men who fain would fight with me, Pierce all who wish me evil, pierce the men who hate me, Amulet!

verses.sa:
तृन्द्धि दर्भ सपत्नान् मे तृन्द्धि मे पृतनायतः ।
तृन्द्धि मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दतृन्द्धि मे द्विषतो मणे॥
verses.tr: tṛnddhi darbha sapatnān me tṛnddhi me pṛtanāyataḥ tṛnddhi me sarvān durhārdatṛnddhi me dviṣato maṇe
verses.en: Split thou my rivals, Darbha, etc, (us in I, with I split' for pierce ' throughout),

verses.sa:
रुन्द्धि दर्भ सपत्नान् मे रुन्द्धि मे पृतनायतः ।
रुन्द्धि मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो रुन्द्धि मे द्विषतो मणे॥
verses.tr: runddhi darbha sapatnān me runddhi me pṛtanāyataḥ runddhi me sarvān durhārdo runddhi me dviṣato maṇe
verses.en: Check thou, etc.

verses.sa:
मृण दर्भ सपत्नान् मे मृण मे पृतनायतः ।
मृण मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो मृण मे द्विषतो मणे॥
verses.tr: mṛṇa darbha sapatnān me mṛṇa me pṛtanāyataḥ mṛṇa me sarvān durhārdo mṛṇa me dviṣato maṇe
verses.en: Crush thou, etc.

verses.sa:
मन्थ दर्भ सपत्नान् मे मन्थ मे पृतनायतः ।
मन्थ मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो मन्थ मे द्विषतो मणे॥
verses.tr: mantha darbha sapatnān me mantha me pṛtanāyataḥ mantha me sarvān durhārdo mantha me dviṣato maṇe
verses.en: Shake thou, etc.

verses.sa:
पिण्ड्ढि दर्भ सपत्नान् मे पिण्ड्ढि मे पृतनायतः ।
पिण्ड्ढि मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो पिण्ड्ढि मे द्विषतो मणे॥
verses.tr: piṇḍḍhi darbha sapatnān me piṇḍḍhi me pṛtanāyataḥ piṇḍḍhi me sarvān durhārdo piṇḍḍhi me dviṣato maṇe
verses.en: Bruise thou, etc.

verses.sa:
ओष दर्भ सपत्नान् मे ओष मे पृतनायतः ।
ओष मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो ओष मे द्विषतो मणे॥
verses.tr: oṣa darbha sapatnān me oṣa me pṛtanāyataḥ oṣa me sarvān durhārdo oṣa me dviṣato maṇe
verses.en: Burn thou, etc.

verses.sa:
दह दर्भ सपत्नान् मे दह मे पृतनायतः ।
दह मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो दह मे द्विषतो मणे॥
verses.tr: daha darbha sapatnān me daha me pṛtanāyataḥ daha me sarvān durhārdo daha me dviṣato maṇe
verses.en: Consume, etc.

verses.sa:
जहि दर्भ सपत्नान् मे जहि मे पृतनायतः ।
जहि मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो जहि मे द्विषतो मणे॥
verses.tr: jahi darbha sapatnān me jahi me pṛtanāyataḥ jahi me sarvān durhārdo jahi me dviṣato maṇe
verses.en: Slay thou my rivals, Darbha, slay the men who fain would fight with me. Slay all who wish me evil, slay the men who hate me, Amulet.

sections.label: A protective charm accompanying investiture
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 30

verses.sa:
यत् ते दर्भ जरामृत्युः शतं वर्मसु वर्म ते ।
तेनेमं वर्मिणं कृत्वा सपत्नां जहि वीर्यैः॥
verses.tr: yat te darbha jarāmṛtyuḥ śataṃ varmasu varma te tenemaṃ varmiṇaṃ kṛtvā sapatnāṃ jahi vīryaiḥ
verses.en: Darbha, with that good shield of thine, of hundred guards till death in eld, Arm thou this man, and with thy might strike thou his adversaries down,

verses.sa:
शतं ते दर्भ वर्माणि सहस्रं वीर्याणि ते ।
तमस्मै विश्वे त्वां देवा जरसे भर्तवा अदुः॥
verses.tr: śataṃ te darbha varmāṇi sahasraṃ vīryāṇi te tamasmai viśve tvāṃ devā jarase bhartavā aduḥ
verses.en: Darbha, thou hast a hundred shields, thou hast a thousand manly powers, K: All Gods have given thee to him to bear thee till extreme old age.

verses.sa:
त्वामाहुर्देववर्म त्वां दर्भ ब्रह्मणस्पतिम्।
त्वामिन्द्रस्याहुर्वर्म त्वं राष्ट्राणि रक्षसि॥
verses.tr: tvāmāhurdevavarma tvāṃ darbha brahmaṇaspatim tvāmindrasyāhurvarma tvaṃ rāṣṭrāṇi rakṣasi
verses.en: They call thee, Darbha, shield of Gods, they call thee Brahmanaspati, x They call thee shield of Indra: thou protectest kingdoms from attack,

verses.sa:
सपत्नक्षयणं दर्भ द्विषतस्तपनं हृदः ।
मणिं क्षत्रस्य वर्धनं तनूपानं कृणोमि ते॥
verses.tr: sapatnakṣayaṇaṃ darbha dviṣatastapanaṃ hṛdaḥ maṇiṃ kṣatrasya vardhanaṃ tanūpānaṃ kṛṇomi te
verses.en: Darbha, destroyer of the foe, vexing the hearts of enemies, An Amulet that strengthens rule I make thee, and the body's guard.

verses.sa:
यत् समुद्रो अभ्यक्रन्दत् पर्जन्यो विद्युता सह।
ततो हिरण्ययो बिन्दुस्ततो दर्भो अजायत॥
verses.tr: yat samudro abhyakrandat parjanyo vidyutā saha tato hiraṇyayo bindustato darbho ajāyata
verses.en: What time Parjanya roared to it with lightning flashes in the sea, Thence came the drop, the golden drop, thence Darbha into being sprang.

sections.label: A charm to ensure general prosperity
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 31

verses.sa:
औदुम्बरेण मणिना पुष्टिकामाय वेधसा ।
पशूणां सर्वेषां स्फातिं गोष्ठे मे सविता करत्॥
verses.tr: audumbareṇa maṇinā puṣṭikāmāya vedhasā paśūṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ sphātiṃ goṣṭhe me savitā karat
verses.en: Savitar make all cattle grow and prosper in my stable with Amulet of Udumbara, helper of him who longs for wealth!

verses.sa:
यो नो अग्निर्गार्हपत्यः पशूनामधिपा असत्।
औदुम्बरो वृषा मणिः सं मा सृजतु पुष्ट्या॥
verses.tr: yo no agnirgārhapatyaḥ paśūnāmadhipā asat audumbaro vṛṣā maṇiḥ saṃ mā sṛjatu puṣṭyā
verses.en: May he who was our Household Fire, the ruler of our cattle, strong Amulet of Udumbara endow us with prosperity.

verses.sa:
करीषिणीं फलवतीं स्वधामिरां च नो गृहे।
औदुम्बरस्य तेजसा धाता पुष्टिं दधातु मे॥
verses.tr: karīṣiṇīṃ phalavatīṃ svadhāmirāṃ ca no gṛhe audumbarasya tejasā dhātā puṣṭiṃ dadhātu me
verses.en: By power of the Udumbara Charm may Dhatar give me plenty, rich In the kine's droppings and in fruit, and, in our dwelling, food, and drink.

verses.sa:
यद् द्विपाच्च चतुष्पाच्च यान्यन्नानि ये रसाः ।
गृह्णे३हं त्वेषां भूमानं बिभ्रदौदुम्बरं मणिम्॥
verses.tr: yad dvipācca catuṣpācca yānyannāni ye rasāḥ gṛhṇe3haṃ tveṣāṃ bhūmānaṃ bibhradaudumbaraṃ maṇim
verses.en: I win great plenty, while I wear the Amulet of Udumbara. Of quadrupeds and bipeds, of juices and food of every sort,

verses.sa:
पुष्टिं पशूनां परि जग्रभाहं चतुष्पदां द्विपदां यच्च धान्यम्।
पयः पशूनां रसमोषधीनां बृहस्पतिः सविता मे नि यच्छात्॥
verses.tr: puṣṭiṃ paśūnāṃ pari jagrabhāhaṃ catuṣpadāṃ dvipadāṃ yacca dhānyam payaḥ paśūnāṃ rasamoṣadhīnāṃ bṛhaspatiḥ savitā me ni yacchāt
verses.en: I have obtained abundant wealth of cattle, bipeds and quadrupeds, and corn in plenty, Savitar and Brihaspati vouchsafe me the milk of kine and herbs' refreshing juices!

verses.sa:
अहं पशूनामधिपा असानि मयि पुष्टं पुष्टपतिर्दधातु ।
मह्यमौदुम्बरो मणिर्द्रविणानि नि यच्छतु॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ paśūnāmadhipā asāni mayi puṣṭaṃ puṣṭapatirdadhātu mahyamaudumbaro maṇirdraviṇāni ni yacchatu
verses.en: Fain would I be the lord of herds of cattle: may he who rules o'er riches send me riches! May the Udumbara Amulet vouchsafe possessions unto me.

verses.sa:
उप मौदुम्बरो मणिः प्रजया च धनेन च ।
इन्द्रेण जिन्वितो मणिरा मागन्त्सह वर्चसा॥
verses.tr: upa maudumbaro maṇiḥ prajayā ca dhanena ca indreṇa jinvito maṇirā māgantsaha varcasā
verses.en: To me with wealth and children come the Amulet of Udumbara, With splendour come the Amulet hastened by Indra on its way!

verses.sa:
देवो मणिः सपत्नहा धनसा धनसातये ।
पशोरन्नस्य भूमानं गवां स्फातिं नि यच्छतु॥
verses.tr: devo maṇiḥ sapatnahā dhanasā dhanasātaye paśorannasya bhūmānaṃ gavāṃ sphātiṃ ni yacchatu
verses.en: Divine, foe-quelling Amulet, wealth-winner for the gain of wealth—May it give store of beasts and food and cause our kine to multiply.

verses.sa:
यथाग्रे त्वं वनस्पते पुष्ठ्या सह जज्ञिषे।
एवा धनस्य मे स्फातिमा दधातु सरस्वती॥
verses.tr: yathāgre tvaṃ vanaspate puṣṭhyā saha jajñiṣe evā dhanasya me sphātimā dadhātu sarasvatī
verses.en: As thou, O Forest Tree, wast born with increase when thy life began, So let Sarasvati bestow abundant growth of wealth on me.

verses.sa:
आ मे धनं सरस्वती पयस्फातिं च धान्यऽम्।
सिनीवाल्युपा वहादयं चौदुम्बरो मणिः॥
verses.tr: ā me dhanaṃ sarasvatī payasphātiṃ ca dhānya'm sinīvālyupā vahādayaṃ caudumbaro maṇiḥ
verses.en: Sarasvati vouchsafe me wealth, household prosperity, and corn! Let Sinivali bring them, and this Amulet of Udumbara.

verses.sa:
त्वं मणीनामधिपा वृषासि त्वयि पुष्टं पुष्टपतिर्जजान ।
त्वयीमे वाजा द्रविणानि सर्वौदुम्बरः स त्वमस्मत् सहस्वारादरातिममतिं क्षुधं च॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ maṇīnāmadhipā vṛṣāsi tvayi puṣṭaṃ puṣṭapatirjajāna tvayīme vājā draviṇāni sarvaudumbaraḥ sa tvamasmat sahasvārādarātimamatiṃ kṣudhaṃ ca
verses.en: The Lord of amulets art thou, most mighty: in thee wealth's ruler hath engendered riches, These gains are lodged in the? and all great treasures. Amulet, conquer "thou: far from us banish malignity, and indigence, and hunger.

verses.sa:
ग्रामणीरसि ग्रामणीरुत्थायाभिषिक्तोऽभि मा सिञ्च वर्चसा ।
तेजोऽसि तेजो मयि धारयाधि रयिरसि रयिं मे धेहि॥
verses.tr: grāmaṇīrasi grāmaṇīrutthāyābhiṣikto'bhi mā siñca varcasā tejo'si tejo mayi dhārayādhi rayirasi rayiṃ me dhehi
verses.en: Vigour art thou, in me do thou plant vigour: riches art thou, so do thou grant me riches, Plenty art thou, so prosper me with plenty: Householder, hear a householder's petition.

verses.sa:
पुष्टिरसि पुष्ट्या मा समङ्ग्धि गृहमेधी गृहपतिं मा कृणु ।
औदुम्बरः स त्वमस्मासु धेहि रयिं च नः सर्ववीरं नि यच्छ रायस्पोषाय प्रति मुञ्चे अहं त्वाम्॥
verses.tr: puṣṭirasi puṣṭyā mā samaṅgdhi gṛhamedhī gṛhapatiṃ mā kṛṇu audumbaraḥ sa tvamasmāsu dhehi rayiṃ ca naḥ sarvavīraṃ ni yaccha rāyaspoṣāya prati muñce ahaṃ tvām
verses.en: Amulet of Udumbara, enrich us: vouchsafe us wealth with all good men about us, I bind thee on for. increase of possessions.

verses.sa:
अयमौदुम्बरो मणिर्वीरो वीराय बध्यते ।
स नः सनिं मधुमतीं कृणोतु रयिं च नः सर्ववीरं नि यच्छात्॥
verses.tr: ayamaudumbaro maṇirvīro vīrāya badhyate sa naḥ saniṃ madhumatīṃ kṛṇotu rayiṃ ca naḥ sarvavīraṃ ni yacchāt
verses.en: For hero is this hero bound, Amulet of Udumbara. So may he make our offering sweetly-savoured, and grant us wealth with all good men about us.

sections.label: A charm, with an amulet of Darbha grass
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 32

verses.sa:
शतकाण्डो दुश्च्यवनः सहस्रपर्ण उत्तिरः ।
दर्भो य उग्र ओषधिस्तं ते बध्नाम्यायुषे॥
verses.tr: śatakāṇḍo duścyavanaḥ sahasraparṇa uttiraḥ darbho ya ugra oṣadhistaṃ te badhnāmyāyuṣe
verses.en: For lengthened life I bind on thee the Darbha grass, the mighty plant, Excellent, hard to overthrow, with hundred stems and thousand blades.

verses.sa:
नास्य केशान् प्र वपन्ति नोरसि ताडमा घ्नते ।
यस्मा अछिन्नपर्णेन दर्भेण शर्म यच्छति॥
verses.tr: nāsya keśān pra vapanti norasi tāḍamā ghnate yasmā achinnaparṇena darbheṇa śarma yacchati
verses.en: They cut not off his hair, they strike blow upon the breast for him To whom one gives protection by Darbha that hath: uninjured leaves,

verses.sa:
दिवि ते तूलमोषधे पृथिव्यामसि निष्ठितः ।
त्वया सहस्रकाण्डेनायुः प्र वर्धयामहे॥
verses.tr: divi te tūlamoṣadhe pṛthivyāmasi niṣṭhitaḥ tvayā sahasrakāṇḍenāyuḥ pra vardhayāmahe
verses.en: O Plant, thy root is in the sky, and thou art stationed on the earth: With thee who hast a thousand: stalks we strengthen all the powers of life.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो दिवो अत्यतृणत् तिस्र इमाः पृथिवीरुत।
त्वयाहं दुर्हार्दो जिह्वां नि तृणद्मि वचांसि॥
verses.tr: tisro divo atyatṛṇat tisra imāḥ pṛthivīruta tvayāhaṃ durhārdo jihvāṃ ni tṛṇadmi vacāṃsi
verses.en: Through all three skies the plant hath pierced, and the three regions of the earth; With thee I split in twain the tongue and words of the bad-hearted man,

verses.sa:
त्वमसि सहमानोऽहमस्मि सहस्वान्।
उभौ सहस्वन्तौ भूत्वा सपत्नान्सहिषीवहि॥
verses.tr: tvamasi sahamāno'hamasmi sahasvān ubhau sahasvantau bhūtvā sapatnānsahiṣīvahi
verses.en: Thou art victorious in thy might: I am endowed with conquering strength: Possessed of overpowering force we two will quell our enemies.

verses.sa:
सहस्व नो अभिमातिं सहस्व पृतनायतः ।
सहस्व सर्वान् दुर्हार्दः सुहार्दो मे बहून् कृधि॥
verses.tr: sahasva no abhimātiṃ sahasva pṛtanāyataḥ sahasva sarvān durhārdaḥ suhārdo me bahūn kṛdhi
verses.en: Subdue our foeman, overcome the men who fain would fight with us. Conquer all evil-hearted ones: make many well-disposed to me.

verses.sa:
दर्भेण देवजातेन दिवि ष्टम्भेन शश्वदित्।
तेनाहं शश्वतो जनाँ असनं सनवानि च॥
verses.tr: darbheṇa devajātena divi ṣṭambhena śaśvadit tenāhaṃ śaśvato janāṃ asanaṃ sanavāni ca
verses.en: With Darbha that hath sprung from Gods, stationed in heaven, full many a time, With this have I won many men, have won and may I win them still.

verses.sa:
प्रियं मा दर्भ कृणु ब्रह्मराजन्याऽभ्यां शूद्राय चार्याय च ।
यस्मै च कामयामहे सर्वस्मै च विपश्यते॥
verses.tr: priyaṃ mā darbha kṛṇu brahmarājanyā'bhyāṃ śūdrāya cāryāya ca yasmai ca kāmayāmahe sarvasmai ca vipaśyate
verses.en: Do thou, O Darbha, make me dear to Brahman and Rajanya, dear to Sidra, and to Arya dear, Yea, dear to every man we love, to every man with eyes to see,

verses.sa:
यो जायमानः पृथिवीमदृंहद् यो अस्तभ्नादन्तरिक्षं दिवं च ।
यं बिभ्रतं ननु पाप्मा विवेद स नोऽयं दर्भो वरुणो दिवा कः॥
verses.tr: yo jāyamānaḥ pṛthivīmadṛṃhad yo astabhnādantarikṣaṃ divaṃ ca yaṃ bibhrataṃ nanu pāpmā viveda sa no'yaṃ darbho varuṇo divā kaḥ
verses.en: He who first born fixed earth in her position, he who established heaven and air's mid-region, Whom sinner ne'er hath known as his supporter,—this Darbha be our shelter and protection!

verses.sa:
सपत्नहा शतकाण्डः सहस्वानोषधीनां प्रथमः सं बभूव ।
स नोऽयं दर्भः परि पातु विश्वतस्तेन साक्षीय पृतनाः पृतन्यतः॥
verses.tr: sapatnahā śatakāṇḍaḥ sahasvānoṣadhīnāṃ prathamaḥ saṃ babhūva sa no'yaṃ darbhaḥ pari pātu viśvatastena sākṣīya pṛtanāḥ pṛtanyataḥ
verses.en: First of all plants it sprang into existence, victorious, hundred-stemmed, the foe-subduer. So may this Darbha from all sides protect us: with this may I subdue our foes in battle.

sections.label: A protective and benediction charm
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 33

verses.sa:
सहस्रार्घः शतकाण्डः पयस्वानपामग्निर्वीरुधां राजसूयम्।
स नोऽयं दर्भः परि पातु विश्वतो देवो मणिरायुषा सं सृजाति नः॥
verses.tr: sahasrārghaḥ śatakāṇḍaḥ payasvānapāmagnirvīrudhāṃ rājasūyam sa no'yaṃ darbhaḥ pari pātu viśvato devo maṇirāyuṣā saṃ sṛjāti naḥ
verses.en: Hundred-stemmed, succulent, and worth a thousand, the Royal Rite of plants, the Water's Agni, Let this same Darbha guard us from all quarters, This Godlike Amulet shall with life endow us.

verses.sa:
घृतादुल्लुप्तो मधुमान् पयस्वान् भूमिदृंहोऽच्युतश्च्यावयिष्णुः ।
नुदन्त्सपत्नानधरांश्च कृण्वन् दर्भा रोह महतामिन्द्रियेण॥
verses.tr: ghṛtādullupto madhumān payasvān bhūmidṛṃho'cyutaścyāvayiṣṇuḥ nudantsapatnānadharāṃśca kṛṇvan darbhā roha mahatāmindriyeṇa
