verses.en: Drawn forth from butter, juicy, sweetly-flavoured, firm as the earth, unshaken, overthrowing, Driving off foes and casting them beneath me, mount. with the strength of mighty Ones, O Darbha.

verses.sa:
त्वं भूमिमत्येष्योजसा त्वं वेद्यां सीदसि चारुरध्वरे।
त्वां पवित्रमृषयोऽभरन्त त्वं पुनीहि दुरितान्यस्मत्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ bhūmimatyeṣyojasā tvaṃ vedyāṃ sīdasi cāruradhvare tvāṃ pavitramṛṣayo'bharanta tvaṃ punīhi duritānyasmat
verses.en: Thou movest o'er the earth with vigour: lovely in sacrifice thou sittest on the altar. The Rishis bear thee as a purifier: cleanse thou us from all evil deeds' defilement.

verses.sa:
तीक्ष्णो राजा विषासही रक्षोहा विश्वचर्षणिः ।
ओजो देवानां बलमुग्रमेतत् तं ते बध्नामि जरसे स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: tīkṣṇo rājā viṣāsahī rakṣohā viśvacarṣaṇiḥ ojo devānāṃ balamugrametat taṃ te badhnāmi jarase svastaye
verses.en: A stern and all-victorious king, foe-queller, dear to every man—That energy of Gods and mighty power, I bind this on thee for long life and welfare,

verses.sa:
दर्भेण त्वं कृणवद् वीर्याऽणि दर्भं बिभ्रदात्मना मा व्यथिष्ठाः ।
अतिष्ठाया वर्चसाधान्यान्त्सूर्य इवा भाहि प्रदिशश्चतस्रः॥
verses.tr: darbheṇa tvaṃ kṛṇavad vīryā'ṇi darbhaṃ bibhradātmanā mā vyathiṣṭhāḥ atiṣṭhāyā varcasādhānyāntsūrya ivā bhāhi pradiśaścatasraḥ
verses.en: Achieve heroic deeds with Darbha; wearing this Darbha never let thy soul be troubled, In splendour and precedence over others illumine like the Sun the heaven's four regions,

sections.label: A protective charm addressed to the panacea called Jangida
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 34

verses.sa:
जाङ्गिडोऽसि जङ्गिडो रक्षितासि जङ्गिडः ।
द्विपाच्चतुष्पादस्माकं सर्वं रक्षतु जङ्गिडः॥
verses.tr: jāṅgiḍo'si jaṅgiḍo rakṣitāsi jaṅgiḍaḥ dvipāccatuṣpādasmākaṃ sarvaṃ rakṣatu jaṅgiḍaḥ
verses.en: Jangida, thou art Angiras: thou art a guardian, Jangida. Let Jangida keep safely all our bipeds and our quadrupeds.

verses.sa:
या गृत्स्यस्त्रिपञ्चाशीः शतं कृत्याकृतश्च ये।
सर्वान् विनक्तु तेजसोऽरसां जङ्गिडस्करत्॥
verses.tr: yā gṛtsyastripañcāśīḥ śataṃ kṛtyākṛtaśca ye sarvān vinaktu tejaso'rasāṃ jaṅgiḍaskarat
verses.en: Dice-witcheries, the fifty-threes, the hundred witch- ' All these may Jangida make weak, bereft of their effectual force.

verses.sa:
अरसं कृत्रिमं नादमरसाः सप्त विस्रसः ।
अपेतो जङ्गिडामतिमिषुमस्तेव शातय॥
verses.tr: arasaṃ kṛtrimaṃ nādamarasāḥ sapta visrasaḥ apeto jaṅgiḍāmatimiṣumasteva śātaya
verses.en: Baffle the loud factitious bowl, make impotent the seven decays, As when an archer speeds the shaft, drive away want, O Jangida.

verses.sa:
कृत्यादूषण एवायमथो अरातिदूषणः ।
अथो सहस्वां जङ्गिडः प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषत्॥
verses.tr: kṛtyādūṣaṇa evāyamatho arātidūṣaṇaḥ atho sahasvāṃ jaṅgiḍaḥ pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat
verses.en: This counteracts the sorceress, this banishes malignity: Then may victorious Jangida prolong the days we have to live,

verses.sa:
स जङ्गिडस्य महिमा परि णः पातु विश्वतः ।
विष्कन्धं येन सासह संस्कन्धमोज ओजसा॥
verses.tr: sa jaṅgiḍasya mahimā pari ṇaḥ pātu viśvataḥ viṣkandhaṃ yena sāsaha saṃskandhamoja ojasā
verses.en: Let Jangida's protecting might encompass us on every side, Wherewith he quells Vishkandha and Sanskandha, might by greater might.

verses.sa:
त्रिष्ट्वा देवा अजनयन् निष्ठितं भूम्यामधि ।
तमु त्वाङ्गिरा इति ब्राह्मणाः पूर्व्या विदुः॥
verses.tr: triṣṭvā devā ajanayan niṣṭhitaṃ bhūmyāmadhi tamu tvāṅgirā iti brāhmaṇāḥ pūrvyā viduḥ
verses.en: Three times the Gods engendered thee fixt on the surface of the earth: The Brahmans of the olden time knew that thy name was Angiras,

verses.sa:
न त्वा पूर्वा ओषधयो न त्वा तरन्ति या नवाः ।
विबाध उग्रो जङ्गिडः परिपाणः सुमङ्गलः॥
verses.tr: na tvā pūrvā oṣadhayo na tvā taranti yā navāḥ vibādha ugro jaṅgiḍaḥ paripāṇaḥ sumaṅgalaḥ
verses.en: The ancient plants surpass thee not, nor any herbs of recent days. A potent charm is Jangida, a most felicitous defence.

verses.sa:
अथोपदान भगवो जाङ्गिडामितवीर्य ।
पुरा त उग्रा ग्रसत उपेन्द्रो वीर्यं ददौ॥
verses.tr: athopadāna bhagavo jāṅgiḍāmitavīrya purā ta ugrā grasata upendro vīryaṃ dadau
verses.en: Then when thou sprangest into life, Jangida of unmeasured strength, Indra, O mighty One, bestowed great power upon thee from the first,

verses.sa:
उग्र इत् ते वनस्पत इन्द्र ओज्मानमादधौ ।
अमीवाः सर्वाश्चातयं जहि रक्षांस्योषधे॥
verses.tr: ugra it te vanaspata indra ojmānamādadhau amīvāḥ sarvāścātayaṃ jahi rakṣāṃsyoṣadhe
verses.en: To thee in truth, O Forest Tree, Indra the mighty One gave strength. Driving away all maladies, strike thou the demons down, O Plant,

verses.sa:
आशरीकं विशरीकं बलासं पृष्ट्यामयम्।
तक्मानं विश्वशारदमरसां जङ्गिडस्करत्॥
verses.tr: āśarīkaṃ viśarīkaṃ balāsaṃ pṛṣṭyāmayam takmānaṃ viśvaśāradamarasāṃ jaṅgiḍaskarat
verses.en: Lumbago and rheumatic pain, consumptive cough, and pleurisy, And fever which each Autumn brings, may Jangida make powerless,

sections.label: A similar charm, addressed to the same
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 35

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य नाम गृह्णन्त ऋसयो जङ्गिडं ददुः ।
देवा यं चक्रुर्भेषजमग्रे विष्कन्धदूषणम्॥
verses.tr: indrasya nāma gṛhṇanta ṛsayo jaṅgiḍaṃ daduḥ devā yaṃ cakrurbheṣajamagre viṣkandhadūṣaṇam
verses.en: While their lips uttered Indra's name the Rishis. gave us Jangicju I Which in the earliest time Gods made a remedy, Vishkandha's cure.

verses.sa:
स नो रक्षतु जङ्गिडो धनपालो धनेव ।
देवा यं चक्रुर्ब्राह्मणाः परिपाणमरातिहम्॥
verses.tr: sa no rakṣatu jaṅgiḍo dhanapālo dhaneva devā yaṃ cakrurbrāhmaṇāḥ paripāṇamarātiham
verses.en: So may this Jangida guard us, even as a treasurer guards wealth, Even this which Gods and Brahmans made a malice-quelling sure defence,

verses.sa:
दुर्हार्दः संघोरं चक्षुः पापकृत्वानमागमम्।
तांस्त्वं सहस्रचक्षो प्रतीबोधेन नाशय परिपाणोऽसि जङ्गिडः॥
verses.tr: durhārdaḥ saṃghoraṃ cakṣuḥ pāpakṛtvānamāgamam tāṃstvaṃ sahasracakṣo pratībodhena nāśaya paripāṇo'si jaṅgiḍaḥ
verses.en: Hard-hearted men, the cruel eye, the sinner who hath come to us, Destroy thou these with watchful care, O thou who hast a thousand eyes, Thou, Jangida, art my defence,

verses.sa:
परि मा दिवः परि मा पृथिव्याः पर्यन्तरिक्षात् परि मा वीरुद्भ्यः ।
परि मा भूतात् परि मोत भव्याद् दिशोदिशो जङ्गिडः पात्वस्मान्॥
verses.tr: pari mā divaḥ pari mā pṛthivyāḥ paryantarikṣāt pari mā vīrudbhyaḥ pari mā bhūtāt pari mota bhavyād diśodiśo jaṅgiḍaḥ pātvasmān
verses.en: Guard me from earth and guard me from the heavens, guard me from middle air, from plants protect me. Protect me from the present and the future. From every region Jangida preserve us!

verses.sa:
य ऋष्णवो देवकृता य उतो ववृतेऽन्यः ।
सर्वांस्तान् विश्वभेषजोऽरसां जङ्गिडस्करत्॥
verses.tr: ya ṛṣṇavo devakṛtā ya uto vavṛte'nyaḥ sarvāṃstān viśvabheṣajo'rasāṃ jaṅgiḍaskarat
verses.en: All sorcerers made by the Gods, all that arise from mortal men, There, one and all, let Jangida, healer of all, make impotent.

sections.label: A charm against disease and evil spirits
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 36

verses.sa:
शतवारो अनीनशद् यक्ष्मान् रक्षांसि तेजसा ।
आरोहन् वर्चसा सह मणिर्दुर्णामचातनः॥
verses.tr: śatavāro anīnaśad yakṣmān rakṣāṃsi tejasā ārohan varcasā saha maṇirdurṇāmacātanaḥ
verses.en: The Hundred-haired hath banished hence fiends and Consumptions by its might, With splendour hath the charm that scares demons of ill-name mounted up.

verses.sa:
शॄङ्गाभ्यां रक्षो नुदते मूलेन यातुधान्यः ।
मध्येन यक्ष्मं बाधते नैनं पाप्माति तत्रति॥
verses.tr: śṝṅgābhyāṃ rakṣo nudate mūlena yātudhānyaḥ madhyena yakṣmaṃ bādhate nainaṃ pāpmāti tatrati
verses.en: It drives off demons with its horns and sorceresses with its root, It stays Consumption with its waist: from this no wickedness escapes,

verses.sa:
ये यक्ष्मासो अर्भका महान्तो ये च शब्दिनः ।
सर्वान् दुर्णामहा मणिः शतवारो अनीनशत्॥
verses.tr: ye yakṣmāso arbhakā mahānto ye ca śabdinaḥ sarvān durṇāmahā maṇiḥ śatavāro anīnaśat
verses.en: Consumptions, light and serious, and those which sounds accompany, All these the Amulet, Hundred-haired, scarer of fiends, hath banished hence.

verses.sa:
शतं वीरानजनयच्छतं यक्ष्मानपावपत्।
दुर्णाम्नः सर्वान् हत्वाव रक्षांसि धूनुते॥
verses.tr: śataṃ vīrānajanayacchataṃ yakṣmānapāvapat durṇāmnaḥ sarvān hatvāva rakṣāṃsi dhūnute
verses.en: A hundred men hath it produced, hundred a pe tions chased away, All fiends of evil-name it hath smitten, and sink the Rakshasas.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यशृङ्ग ऋषभः शातवारो अयं मणिः ।
दुर्णाम्नः सर्वांस्तृड्ढ्वाव रक्षांस्यक्रमीत्॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyaśṛṅga ṛṣabhaḥ śātavāro ayaṃ maṇiḥ durṇāmnaḥ sarvāṃstṛḍḍhvāva rakṣāṃsyakramīt
verses.en: ihe Bull that weareth horns of gold, this Amulet with hundred hairs, Hath cleft the demons of ill-name and overcome the rakshasas.

verses.sa:
शतमहं दुर्णाम्नीनां गन्धर्वाप्सरसां शतम्।
शतं शश्वन्वतीनां शतवारेण वारये॥
verses.tr: śatamahaṃ durṇāmnīnāṃ gandharvāpsarasāṃ śatam śataṃ śaśvanvatīnāṃ śatavāreṇa vāraye
verses.en: Hundred she-fiends, a hundred of Gandharvas and Apsarases, A hundred of dog-mated nymphs, I keep away with Hundred-hair.

sections.label: A charm to secure long life and dominion to a prince
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 37

verses.sa:
इदं वर्चो अग्निना दत्तमागन् भर्गो यशः सह ओजो वयो बलम्।
त्रयस्त्रिंशद् यानि च वीर्याणि तान्यग्निः प्र ददातु मे॥
verses.tr: idaṃ varco agninā dattamāgan bhargo yaśaḥ saha ojo vayo balam trayastriṃśad yāni ca vīryāṇi tānyagniḥ pra dadātu me
verses.en: To me hath come this word given by Agni, fame, force and might, and strength, and life, and lustre, May Agni too bestow on me three-times a hundred manly powers.

verses.sa:
वर्च आ धेहि मे तन्वां३ सह ओजो वयो बलम्।
इन्द्रियाय त्वा कर्मणे वीर्याय प्रति गृह्णामि शतशारदाय॥
verses.tr: varca ā dhehi me tanvāṃ3 saha ojo vayo balam indriyāya tvā karmaṇe vīryāya prati gṛhṇāmi śataśāradāya
verses.en: For mighty strength, for action, I receive thee, for manly power, to last a hundred autumns,

verses.sa:
ऊर्जे त्वा बलाय त्वौजसे सहसे त्वा ।
अभिभूयाय त्वा राष्ट्रभृत्याय पर्यूहामि शतशारदाय॥
verses.tr: ūrje tvā balāya tvaujase sahase tvā abhibhūyāya tvā rāṣṭrabhṛtyāya paryūhāmi śataśāradāya
verses.en: For conquering strength and energy and vigour: I fasten thee, for chieftainship, for bearing royal dominion through a hundred autumns,

verses.sa:
ऋतुभ्यष्ट्वार्तवेभ्यो माद्भ्यः संवत्सरेभ्यः ।
धात्रे विधात्रे समृधे भूतस्य पतये यजे॥
verses.tr: ṛtubhyaṣṭvārtavebhyo mādbhyaḥ saṃvatsarebhyaḥ dhātre vidhātre samṛdhe bhūtasya pataye yaje
verses.en: With Seasons and with Season-groups, for vigour and extended life, With splendour of the perfect year we fasten thee about the neck.

sections.label: A protective charm
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 38

verses.sa:
न तं यक्ष्मा अरुन्धते नैनं शपथो अश्नुते ।
यं भेषजस्य गुल्गुलोः सुरभिर्गन्धो अश्नुते॥
verses.tr: na taṃ yakṣmā arundhate nainaṃ śapatho aśnute yaṃ bheṣajasya gulguloḥ surabhirgandho aśnute
verses.en: Never Consumption, never curse touches the man, Aruudhati! Whom the delicious odour of the healing Bdellium penetrates,

verses.sa:
विष्वञ्चस्तस्माद् यक्ष्मा मृगा अश्वा इवेरते ।
यद् गुल्गुलु सैन्धवं यद् वाप्यासि समुद्रियम्॥
उभयोरग्रभं नामास्मा अरिष्टतातये॥
verses.tr: viṣvañcastasmād yakṣmā mṛgā aśvā iverate yad gulgulu saindhavaṃ yad vāpyāsi samudriyam ubhayoragrabhaṃ nāmāsmā ariṣṭatātaye
verses.en: Consumptions flee apart from it as from a wild beast fly the deer. If thou, O Bdellium, art produced from Sindhu or hast come from sea, The quality of both have I taken to keep this man unscathed.

sections.label: A protective charm
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 39

verses.sa:
ऐतु देवस्त्रायमाणः कुष्ठो हिमवतस्परि ।
तक्मानं सर्वं नाशय सर्वाश्च यातुधान्यः॥
verses.tr: aitu devastrāyamāṇaḥ kuṣṭho himavataspari takmānaṃ sarvaṃ nāśaya sarvāśca yātudhānyaḥ
verses.en: Let Kushtha from the Hill of Snow come, a divine deliverer, Banish thou all Consumption, drive all sorceresses far away.

verses.sa:
त्रीणि ते कुष्ठ नामानि नद्यमारो नद्यारिषः ।
नद्यायं पुरुषो रिषत्।
यस्मै परिब्रवीमि त्वा सायंप्रातरथो दिवा॥
verses.tr: trīṇi te kuṣṭha nāmāni nadyamāro nadyāriṣaḥ nadyāyaṃ puruṣo riṣat yasmai paribravīmi tvā sāyaṃprātaratho divā
verses.en: Kushtha, three several names hast thou, Naghamara, Nagharisha: let not mishap befall this man, For whom I make a charm of thee at eve, at morning, and by day.

verses.sa:
जीवला नाम ते माता जीवन्तो नाम ते पिता।
नद्यायं पुरुषो रिषत्।
यस्मै परिब्रवीमि त्वा सायंप्रातरथो दिवा॥
verses.tr: jīvalā nāma te mātā jīvanto nāma te pitā nadyāyaṃ puruṣo riṣat yasmai paribravīmi tvā sāyaṃprātaratho divā
verses.en: Jivala is thy mother's name, thy father's name is Jivala: let not mishap, eto.

verses.sa:
उत्तमो अस्योषधीनामनड्वान् जगतामिव व्याघ्रः श्वपदामिव ।
नद्यायं पुरुषो रिषत्।
यस्मै परिब्रवीमि त्वा सायंप्रातरथो दिवा॥
verses.tr: uttamo asyoṣadhīnāmanaḍvān jagatāmiva vyāghraḥ śvapadāmiva nadyāyaṃ puruṣo riṣat yasmai paribravīmi tvā sāyaṃprātaratho divā
verses.en: Thou art the best amid the plants, even as the ox is best of tame, the tiger of rapacious beasts: let not mishap, etc.

verses.sa:
त्रिः शाम्बुभ्यो अङ्गिरेभ्यस्त्रिरादित्येभ्यस्परि ।
त्रिर्जातो विश्वदेवेभ्यः ।
स कुष्ठो विश्वभेषजः साकं सोमेन तिष्ठति ।
तक्मानं सर्वं नाशय सर्वाश्च यातुधान्यः॥
verses.tr: triḥ śāmbubhyo aṅgirebhyastrirādityebhyaspari trirjāto viśvadevebhyaḥ sa kuṣṭho viśvabheṣajaḥ sākaṃ somena tiṣṭhati takmānaṃ sarvaṃ nāśaya sarvāśca yātudhānyaḥ
verses.en: Born thrice from the Adityas, thrice from Bhrigus, thrice from Angiras' sons, born from the Visve Devas thrice, Healer of every malady, that Kushtha stands by Soma's side. i Banish thou all Consumption, drive all sorceresses far away.

verses.sa:
अश्वत्थो देवसदनस्तृतीयस्यामितो दिवि।
तत्रामृतस्य चक्षणं ततः कुष्ठो अजायत ।
स कुष्ठो विश्वभेषजः साकं सोमेन तिष्ठति ।
तक्मानं सर्वं नाशय सर्वाश्च यातुधान्यः॥
verses.tr: aśvattho devasadanastṛtīyasyāmito divi tatrāmṛtasya cakṣaṇaṃ tataḥ kuṣṭho ajāyata sa kuṣṭho viśvabheṣajaḥ sākaṃ somena tiṣṭhati takmānaṃ sarvaṃ nāśaya sarvāśca yātudhānyaḥ
verses.en: In the third heaven above us stands the Asvattha tree, the seat of Gods: There is embodiment of life that dies not: thence was Kushtha born.

verses.sa:
हिरण्ययी नौरचरद्धिरण्यबन्धना दिवि।
तत्रामृतस्य चक्षणं ततः कुष्ठो अजायत ।
स कुष्ठो विश्वभेषजः साकं सोमेन तिष्ठति ।
तक्मानं सर्वं नाशय सर्वाश्च यातुधान्यः॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyayī nauracaraddhiraṇyabandhanā divi tatrāmṛtasya cakṣaṇaṃ tataḥ kuṣṭho ajāyata sa kuṣṭho viśvabheṣajaḥ sākaṃ somena tiṣṭhati takmānaṃ sarvaṃ nāśaya sarvāśca yātudhānyaḥ
verses.en: There moved through heaven a golden ship, a ship with cordage wrought of gold: l There is embodiment of life that dies not; thence was Kushtha born.

verses.sa:
यत्र नावप्रभ्रंशनं यत्र हिमवतः शिरः ।
तत्रामृतस्य चक्षणं ततः कुष्ठो अजायत ।
स कुष्ठो विश्वभेषजः साकं सोमेन तिष्ठति ।
तक्मानं सर्वं नाशय सर्वाश्च यातुधान्यः॥
verses.tr: yatra nāvaprabhraṃśanaṃ yatra himavataḥ śiraḥ tatrāmṛtasya cakṣaṇaṃ tataḥ kuṣṭho ajāyata sa kuṣṭho viśvabheṣajaḥ sākaṃ somena tiṣṭhati takmānaṃ sarvaṃ nāśaya sarvāśca yātudhānyaḥ
verses.en: Where is the Sinking of the Ship, the summit of the Hill of Snow, There is embodiment of life that dies not: thence was Kushtha born. 'Healer of every malady, that Kushtha stands by Soma's side, Banish thou all Consumption, drive all sorceresses for away,

verses.sa:
यं त्वा वेद पूर्व इक्ष्वाको यं वा त्वा कुष्ठ काम्यः ।
यं वा वसो यमात्स्यस्तेनासि विश्वभेषजः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ tvā veda pūrva ikṣvāko yaṃ vā tvā kuṣṭha kāmyaḥ yaṃ vā vaso yamātsyastenāsi viśvabheṣajaḥ
verses.en: Thou whom Ikshvaku's ancestor, whom he who well loved Kushtha, knew, Whom Vayasa and Matsya knew, hence healer of all ills art thou,

verses.sa:
शीर्षलोकं तृतीयकं सदन्दिर्यश्च हायनः ।
तक्मानं विश्वधावीर्याधराञ्चं परा सुव॥
verses.tr: śīrṣalokaṃ tṛtīyakaṃ sadandiryaśca hāyanaḥ takmānaṃ viśvadhāvīryādharāñcaṃ parā suva
verses.en: O thou who hast all-reaching might drive away Fever, drive it down, Head-racking Fever, tertian, continual, lasting for a year,

sections.label: A prayer for pardon of error in sacrifice, and for wisdom, strength
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 40

verses.sa:
यन्मे छिद्रं मनसो यच्च वाचः सरस्वती मन्युमन्तं जगाम ।
विश्वैस्तद् देवैः सह संविदानः सं दधातु बृहस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: yanme chidraṃ manaso yacca vācaḥ sarasvatī manyumantaṃ jagāma viśvaistad devaiḥ saha saṃvidānaḥ saṃ dadhātu bṛhaspatiḥ
verses.en: For each defect of mine in voice and spirit I have approached One vehement and ardent, With all the Deities, fully approving, Brihaspati supply the want!

verses.sa:
मा न आपो मेधां मा ब्रह्म प्र मथिष्टन ।
सुष्यदा यूयं स्यन्दध्वमुपहूतोऽहं सुमेधा वर्चस्वी॥
verses.tr: mā na āpo medhāṃ mā brahma pra mathiṣṭana suṣyadā yūyaṃ syandadhvamupahūto'haṃ sumedhā varcasvī
verses.en: Disturb ye not our intellect, O Waters, nor the power of prayer. Glide on your way, strength-giving, invocated: may I be vigorous and wise.

verses.sa:
मा नो मेधां मा नो दीक्षां मा नो हिंसिष्टं यत् तपः ।
शिवा नः शं सन्त्वायुषे शिवा भवन्तु मातरः॥
verses.tr: mā no medhāṃ mā no dīkṣāṃ mā no hiṃsiṣṭaṃ yat tapaḥ śivā naḥ śaṃ santvāyuṣe śivā bhavantu mātaraḥ
verses.en: Mar not our consecrating rite, our intellect, or fervent zeal, Gracious to us for lengthened life, propitious let the Mothers be.

verses.sa:
या नः पीपरदश्विना ज्योतिष्मती तमस्तिरः ।
तामस्मे रासतामिषम्॥
verses.tr: yā naḥ pīparadaśvinā jyotiṣmatī tamastiraḥ tāmasme rāsatāmiṣam
verses.en: Vouchsafe to us, ye Asvins twain, such strength as, with attendant light, May through the darkness carry us.

sections.label: A benediction on a newly elected king
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 41

verses.sa:
भद्रमिच्छन्त ऋषयः स्वर्विदस्तपो दीक्षामुपनिषेदुरग्रे ।
ततो राष्ट्रं बलमोजश्च जातं तदस्मै देवा उपसंनमन्तु॥
verses.tr: bhadramicchanta ṛṣayaḥ svarvidastapo dīkṣāmupaniṣeduragre tato rāṣṭraṃ balamojaśca jātaṃ tadasmai devā upasaṃnamantu
verses.en: Desiring bliss, at first, light-finding Rishis began religious rite and holy fervour. i. Thence energy was born, and might, and kingship: so to this man let gathered Gods incline them,

sections.label: Iti praise of Brahma, Prayer, or Devotion
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 42

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म होता ब्रह्म यज्ञा ब्रह्मणा स्वरवो मिताः ।
अध्वर्युर्ब्रह्मणो जातो ब्रह्मणोऽन्तर्हितं हविः॥
verses.tr: brahma hotā brahma yajñā brahmaṇā svaravo mitāḥ adhvaryurbrahmaṇo jāto brahmaṇo'ntarhitaṃ haviḥ
verses.en: Brahma is Hotar, sacrifice: with Brahma are the stakes set up. From Brahma was the Adhvaryu born, from Brahma hidden offering,

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म स्रुचो घृतवतीर्ब्रह्मणा वेदिरुद्धिता ।
ब्रह्म यज्ञस्य तत्त्वं च ऋत्विजो ये हविष्कृतः ।
शमिताय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: brahma sruco ghṛtavatīrbrahmaṇā vediruddhitā brahma yajñasya tattvaṃ ca ṛtvijo ye haviṣkṛtaḥ śamitāya svāhā
verses.en: Brahma is fatness-dropping scoops: with Brahma was the altar reared. Brahma is worship, lengthened rite, the Rishis who pay sacrifice, the victim's Immolators, Hail!

verses.sa:
अंहोमुचे प्र भरे मनीषामा सुत्राव्णे सुमतिमावृणानः ।
इदमिन्द्र प्रति हव्यं गृभाय सत्याः सन्तु यजमानस्य कामाः॥
verses.tr: aṃhomuce pra bhare manīṣāmā sutrāvṇe sumatimāvṛṇānaḥ idamindra prati havyaṃ gṛbhāya satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ
verses.en: To him who frees from woe mine hymn I offer, to the Good Guardian, as I seek his favour. Accept this offering of mine, O Indra, Fulfilled be all the sacrificer's wishes!

verses.sa:
अंहोमुचं वृषभं यज्ञियानां विराजन्तं प्रथममध्वराणाम्।
अपां नपातमश्विना हुवे धिय इन्द्रियेण त इन्द्रियं दत्तमोजः॥
verses.tr: aṃhomucaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ yajñiyānāṃ virājantaṃ prathamamadhvarāṇām apāṃ napātamaśvinā huve dhiya indriyeṇa ta indriyaṃ dattamojaḥ
verses.en: With prayer I call on him who frees from trouble, Prince of Gods, Splendid, chief of sacrifices, I call the Waters' Child and both the Asvins. Vigour is mine, and strength bestowed by Indra.

sections.label: In praise of Brahma, Prayer, or Devotion
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 43

verses.sa:
यत्र ब्रह्मविदो यान्ति दीक्षया तपसा सह।
अग्निर्मा तत्र नयत्वग्निर्मेधा दधातु मे । अग्नये स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yatra brahmavido yānti dīkṣayā tapasā saha agnirmā tatra nayatvagnirmedhā dadhātu me agnaye svāhā
verses.en: Whither men versed in Brahma go, with fervour' and the cleansing rite, Thither let Agni lead me, let Agni give me intelligence. All hail to Agni!

verses.sa:
यत्र ब्रह्मविदो यान्ति दीक्षया तपसा सह।
वायुर्मा तत्र नयतु वायुः प्राणान् दधातु मे। वायवे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yatra brahmavido yānti dīkṣayā tapasā saha vāyurmā tatra nayatu vāyuḥ prāṇān dadhātu me vāyave svāhā
verses.en: Whither, etc. Thither let Vayu lead me, let Vayu vouchsafe me-vital breath, All hail to Vayu!

verses.sa:
यत्र ब्रह्मविदो यान्ति दीक्षया तपसा सह।
सूर्यो मा तत्र नयतु चक्षुः सूर्यो दधातु मे । सूर्याय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yatra brahmavido yānti dīkṣayā tapasā saha sūryo mā tatra nayatu cakṣuḥ sūryo dadhātu me sūryāya svāhā
verses.en: Whither, etc, Thither let Strya lead me, let Stirya vouchsafe me power of sight. All hail to Surya!

verses.sa:
यत्र ब्रह्मविदो यान्ति दीक्षया तपसा सह।
चन्द्रो मा तत्र नयतु मनश्चन्द्रो दधातु मे । चन्द्राय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yatra brahmavido yānti dīkṣayā tapasā saha candro mā tatra nayatu manaścandro dadhātu me candrāya svāhā
verses.en: Whither, etc. Thither let Chandra lead me, let Chandra vouchsafe me intellect, All hail bo, Chandra!

verses.sa:
यत्र ब्रह्मविदो यान्ति दीक्षया तपसा सह।
सोमो मा तत्र नयतु पयः सोमो दधातु मे । सोमाय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yatra brahmavido yānti dīkṣayā tapasā saha somo mā tatra nayatu payaḥ somo dadhātu me somāya svāhā
verses.en: Whither, etc, Thither let Soma lead me, let Soma vouchsafe me vital sap. All hail to Soma!

verses.sa:
यत्र ब्रह्मविदो यान्ति दीक्षया तपसा सह।
इन्द्रो मा तत्र नयतु बलमिन्द्रो दधातु मे । इन्द्राय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yatra brahmavido yānti dīkṣayā tapasā saha indro mā tatra nayatu balamindro dadhātu me indrāya svāhā
verses.en: Whither, etc. Thither let Indra lead me, let Indra bestow upon me power. All hail to Indra t

verses.sa:
यत्र ब्रह्मविदो यान्ति दीक्षया तपसा सह।
आपो मा तत्र नयत्वमृतं मोप तिष्ठतु । अद्भ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yatra brahmavido yānti dīkṣayā tapasā saha āpo mā tatra nayatvamṛtaṃ mopa tiṣṭhatu adbhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Whither, eta Thither, let Waters lead me, let the Waters give me deathless life. All hail to Waters!

verses.sa:
यत्र ब्रह्मविदो यान्ति दीक्षया तपसा सह।
ब्रह्मा मा तत्र नयतु ब्रह्मा ब्रह्म दधातु मे । ब्रह्मणे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yatra brahmavido yānti dīkṣayā tapasā saha brahmā mā tatra nayatu brahmā brahma dadhātu me brahmaṇe svāhā
verses.en: Whither, etc. Thither let Brahma lead me, let Brahma give Brahma unto me. All hail to Brahma!

sections.label: A curative and protective charm
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 44

verses.sa:
आयुषोऽसि प्रतरणं विप्रं भेषजमुच्यसे ।
तदाञ्जन त्वं शंताते शमापो अभयं कृतम्॥
verses.tr: āyuṣo'si prataraṇaṃ vipraṃ bheṣajamucyase tadāñjana tvaṃ śaṃtāte śamāpo abhayaṃ kṛtam
verses.en: Thou art the lengthening of life, thy name is Universal Cure: Then, Ointment! send felicity; Waters, send happiness and peace,

verses.sa:
यो हरिमा जायान्योऽङ्गभेदो विसल्पकः ।
सर्वं ते यक्ष्ममङ्गेभ्यो बहिर्निर्हन्त्वाञ्जनम्॥
verses.tr: yo harimā jāyānyo'ṅgabhedo visalpakaḥ sarvaṃ te yakṣmamaṅgebhyo bahirnirhantvāñjanam
verses.en: The yellow hue, the feverish heat, the shooting pain that rends the limbs, All the consumptive malady let the Ointment drive from out thy frame.

verses.sa:
आञ्जनं पृथिव्यां जातं भद्रं पुरुषजीवनम्।
कृणोत्वप्रमायुकं रथजूतिमनागसम्॥
verses.tr: āñjanaṃ pṛthivyāṃ jātaṃ bhadraṃ puruṣajīvanam kṛṇotvapramāyukaṃ rathajūtimanāgasam
verses.en: Let the Salve born upon the earth, benignant, giving life to man, Make the swift rider on the car sinless, exempt from sudden death,

verses.sa:
प्राण प्राणं त्रायस्वासो असवे मृड ।
निरृते निरृत्या नः पाशेभ्यो मुञ्च॥
verses.tr: prāṇa prāṇaṃ trāyasvāso asave mṛḍa nirṛte nirṛtyā naḥ pāśebhyo muñca
verses.en: Preserve our breath, O Vital Breath, have mercy on our life, O Life. From snares of Nirriti do thou, O Nirriti, deliver us.

verses.sa:
सिन्धोर्गर्भोऽसि विद्युतां पुष्पम्।
वातः प्राणः सूर्यश्चक्षुर्दिवस्पयः॥
verses.tr: sindhorgarbho'si vidyutāṃ puṣpam vātaḥ prāṇaḥ sūryaścakṣurdivaspayaḥ
verses.en: Thou art the babe of Sindhu, thou art lightnings' flower, wind, breath, and Sun: thou art the eye and milk of heaven,

verses.sa:
देवाञ्जन त्रैककुदं परि मा पाहि विश्वतः ।
न त्वा तरन्त्योषधयो बाह्याः पर्वतीया उत॥
verses.tr: devāñjana traikakudaṃ pari mā pāhi viśvataḥ na tvā tarantyoṣadhayo bāhyāḥ parvatīyā uta
verses.en: Gods' Ointment from the Three Peaked Hill, preserve thou me on every side, No plants of earth surpass thee, none from mountain or from cultured ground.

verses.sa:
वी३दं मध्यमवासृपद् रक्षोहामीवचातनः ।
अमीवाः सर्वाश्चातयन् नाशयदभिभा इतः॥
verses.tr: vī3daṃ madhyamavāsṛpad rakṣohāmīvacātanaḥ amīvāḥ sarvāścātayan nāśayadabhibhā itaḥ
verses.en: Now hath it gently crept within, fiend-slaying, chasing malady, And driving all diseases hence, and evil omens, banished them.

verses.sa:
बह्वि३दं राजन् वरुणानृतमाह पूरुषः ।
तस्मात् सहस्रवीर्य मुञ्च नः पर्यंहसः॥
verses.tr: bahvi3daṃ rājan varuṇānṛtamāha pūruṣaḥ tasmāt sahasravīrya muñca naḥ paryaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Full many a falsehood, O thou King Varuna, man hath uttered here: Do thou who hast a thousand powers preserve us from that misery.

verses.sa:
यदापो अघ्न्या इति वरुणेति यदूचिम।
तस्मात् सहस्रवीर्य मुञ्च नः पर्यंहसः॥
verses.tr: yadāpo aghnyā iti varuṇeti yadūcima tasmāt sahasravīrya muñca naḥ paryaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: If we have cried, O Waters! Cows! if we have cried, O Varuna! For this, endowed with thousand powers! deliver us from misery.

verses.sa:
मित्रश्च त्वा वरुणश्चानुप्रेयतुराञ्जन ।
तौ त्वानुगत्य दूरं भोगाय पुनरोहतुः॥
verses.tr: mitraśca tvā varuṇaścānupreyaturāñjana tau tvānugatya dūraṃ bhogāya punarohatuḥ
verses.en: Mitra and Varuna, O Salve, have closely followed after thee: May they, when they have followed thee afar, restore thee for our use.

sections.label: A curative and protective charm
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 45

verses.sa:
ऋणादृणमिव संनयन् कृत्यां कृत्याकृतो गृहम्।
चक्षुर्मन्त्रस्य दुर्हार्दः पृष्टीरपि शृणाञ्जन॥
verses.tr: ṛṇādṛṇamiva saṃnayan kṛtyāṃ kṛtyākṛto gṛham cakṣurmantrasya durhārdaḥ pṛṣṭīrapi śṛṇāñjana
verses.en: As debt from debt repay and send sorcery to the sorcerer's house. Split, Salve! the cruel villain's ribs whose evil eye bewitches us.

verses.sa:
यदस्मासु दुष्वप्न्यं यद् गोषु यच्च नो गृहे।
अनामगस्तं च दुर्हार्दः प्रियः प्रति मुञ्चताम्॥
verses.tr: yadasmāsu duṣvapnyaṃ yad goṣu yacca no gṛhe anāmagastaṃ ca durhārdaḥ priyaḥ prati muñcatām
verses.en: Whatver evil dream we have, whate'er befall our kine or home, Be this that is salubrity, the evil-hearted's foe applied.

verses.sa:
अपामूर्ज ओजसो वावृधानमग्नेर्जातमधि जातवेदसः ।
चतुर्वीरं पर्वतीयं यदाञ्जनं दिशः प्रदिशः करदिच्छिवास्ते॥
verses.tr: apāmūrja ojaso vāvṛdhānamagnerjātamadhi jātavedasaḥ caturvīraṃ parvatīyaṃ yadāñjanaṃ diśaḥ pradiśaḥ karadicchivāste
verses.en: Increasing from the Waters' strength and vigour, sprung into life from Agni Jatavedas, Strong as four heroes, mountain-born, this Ointment make for thee quarters and mind-points auspicious!

verses.sa:
चतुर्वीरं बध्यत आञ्जनं ते सर्वा दिशो अभयास्ते भवन्तु ।
ध्रुवस्तिष्ठासि सवितेव चार्य इमा विशो अभि हरन्तु ते बलिम्॥
verses.tr: caturvīraṃ badhyata āñjanaṃ te sarvā diśo abhayāste bhavantu dhruvastiṣṭhāsi saviteva cārya imā viśo abhi harantu te balim
verses.en: On thee is laid the Chaturvira Ointment: let all the regions give thee peace and safety. Secure like precious Savitar thou standest: to thee let all these regions bring their tribute.

verses.sa:
आक्ष्वैकं मणिमेकं कृष्णुष्व स्नाह्येकेना पिबैकमेषाम्।
चतुर्वीरं नैरृतेभ्यश्चतुर्भ्यो ग्राह्या बन्धेभ्यः परि पात्वस्मान्॥
अग्निर्माग्निनावतु प्राणायापानायायुषे वर्चस ओजसे तेजसे स्वस्तये सुभूतये स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ākṣvaikaṃ maṇimekaṃ kṛṣṇuṣva snāhyekenā pibaikameṣām caturvīraṃ nairṛtebhyaścaturbhyo grāhyā bandhebhyaḥ pari pātvasmān agnirmāgnināvatu prāṇāyāpānāyāyuṣe varcasa ojase tejase svastaye subhūtaye svāhā
verses.en: Make one thy salve, thine amulet another, drink one, and with another bathe thy body. So let the Chaturvira keep us guarded from the four bonds of Nirriti and Grahi, f May Agni protect me with fire for inspiration and expiration, for strength, for energy, for vigour, for weal and prosperity, All Hail!

verses.sa: इन्द्रो मेन्द्रियेणावतु प्राणायापानायायुषे वर्चस ओजसे तेजसे स्वस्तये सुभूतये स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: indro mendriyeṇāvatu prāṇāyāpānāyāyuṣe varcasa ojase tejase svastaye subhūtaye svāhā
verses.en: May Indra protect me with his Indra-power for inspiration, etc.

verses.sa: सोमो मा सौम्येनावतु प्राणायापानायायुषे वर्चस ओजसे तेजसे स्वस्तये सुभूतये स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: somo mā saumyenāvatu prāṇāyāpānāyāyuṣe varcasa ojase tejase svastaye subhūtaye svāhā
verses.en: May Soma protect me with Soma-power, etc.

verses.sa: भगो मा भगेनावतु प्राणायापानायायुषे वर्चस ओजसे तेजसे स्वस्तये सुभूतये स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: bhago mā bhagenāvatu prāṇāyāpānāyāyuṣe varcasa ojase tejase svastaye subhūtaye svāhā
verses.en: May Bhaga with good fortune protect me, etc,

verses.sa: मरुतो मा गणैरवन्तु प्राणायापानायुषे वर्चस ओजसे तेजसे स्वस्तये सुभूतये स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: maruto mā gaṇairavantu prāṇāyāpānāyuṣe varcasa ojase tejase svastaye subhūtaye svāhā
verses.en: May the Maruts protect me with their troops for inspiration and expiration, for strength, for energy, for vigour, for weal and prosperity, All Hail!

sections.label: A charm accompanying investiture
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 46

verses.sa:
प्रजापतिष्ट्वा बध्नात् प्रथममस्तृतं वीर्याय कम्।
तत् ते बध्नाम्यायुषे वर्चस ओजसे च बलाय चास्तृतस्त्वाभि रक्षतु॥
verses.tr: prajāpatiṣṭvā badhnāt prathamamastṛtaṃ vīryāya kam tat te badhnāmyāyuṣe varcasa ojase ca balāya cāstṛtastvābhi rakṣatu
verses.en: For manly strength Prajapati bound thee on first, invincible. This for long life on thee I bind for splendour, strength, and energy. Invincible, let it guard thee well,

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वस्तिष्ठतु रक्षन्नप्रमादमस्तृतेमं मा त्वा दभन् पणयो यातुधानाः ।
इन्द्र इव दस्यूनव धूनुष्व पृतन्यतः सर्वांछत्रून् वि षहस्वास्तृतस्त्वाभि रक्षतु॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvastiṣṭhatu rakṣannapramādamastṛtemaṃ mā tvā dabhan paṇayo yātudhānāḥ indra iva dasyūnava dhūnuṣva pṛtanyataḥ sarvāṃchatrūn vi ṣahasvāstṛtastvābhi rakṣatu
verses.en: Erect, invincible, be this man's watchful keeper: let not the Panis or the sorcerers harm thee, Shake off thy foes as Indra scattered Dasyus: quell all enemies. Invincible, let it guard thee well,

verses.sa:
शतं च न प्रहरन्तो निघ्नन्तो न तस्तिरे।
तस्मिन्निन्द्रः पर्यदत्त चक्षुः प्राणमथो बलमस्तृतस्त्वाभि रक्षतु॥
verses.tr: śataṃ ca na praharanto nighnanto na tastire tasminnindraḥ paryadatta cakṣuḥ prāṇamatho balamastṛtastvābhi rakṣatu
verses.en: Indra hath lent the power of sight, and vital breath and strength to this, Whom even a hundred combatants, striking, have failed to overcome, Invincible, let it guard thee well,

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य त्वा वर्मणा परि धापयामो यो देवानामधिराजो बभूव ।
पुनस्त्वा देवाः प्र णयन्तु सर्वेऽस्तृतस्त्वाभि रक्षतु॥
verses.tr: indrasya tvā varmaṇā pari dhāpayāmo yo devānāmadhirājo babhūva punastvā devāḥ pra ṇayantu sarve'stṛtastvābhi rakṣatu
verses.en: Around thy limbs I place the mail of Indra. who hath become the Gods' imperial Sovran, Again let all the Deities bring thee hither, Invincible let it guard thee well,

verses.sa:
अस्मिन् मणावेकशतं वीर्याणि सहस्रं प्राणा अस्मिन्नस्तृते ।
व्याघ्रः शत्रूनभि तिष्ठ सर्वान् यस्त्वा पृतन्यादधरः सो अस्त्वस्तृतस्त्वाभि रक्षतु॥
verses.tr: asmin maṇāvekaśataṃ vīryāṇi sahasraṃ prāṇā asminnastṛte vyāghraḥ śatrūnabhi tiṣṭha sarvān yastvā pṛtanyādadharaḥ so astvastṛtastvābhi rakṣatu
verses.en: One and a hundred manly powers, a thousand lives hath this Amulet, unconquered ever. Go forth a tiger, strike down all thy foemen: let him who would oppose fall low beneath thee. Invincible, let it guard thee well.

verses.sa:
घृतादुल्लुप्तो मधुमान् पयस्वान्त्सहस्रप्राणः शतयोनिर्वयोधाः ।
शम्भूश्च मयोभूश्चोर्जस्वांश्च पयस्वांश्चास्तृतस्त्वाभि रक्षतु॥
verses.tr: ghṛtādullupto madhumān payasvāntsahasraprāṇaḥ śatayonirvayodhāḥ śambhūśca mayobhūścorjasvāṃśca payasvāṃścāstṛtastvābhi rakṣatu
verses.en: Drawn forth from butter, rich in milk and sweetness, hundred-lived, thousand-homed, bestowing vigour, Kindly, delightsome, full of sap, and mighty, invincible let it guard thee well.

verses.sa:
यथा त्वमुत्तरोऽसो असपत्नः सपत्नहा।
सजातानामसद् वशी तथा त्वा सविता करदस्तृतस्त्वाभि रक्षतु॥
verses.tr: yathā tvamuttaro'so asapatnaḥ sapatnahā sajātānāmasad vaśī tathā tvā savitā karadastṛtastvābhi rakṣatu
verses.en: That thou mayst be preeminent, slayer of rivals, rivalless, May Savitar cause thee to be chief and controller of thy kin. Invincible, let it guard thee well.

sections.label: A hymn to Night for protection from fiends, robbers, snakes, and wolves
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 47

verses.sa:
आ रात्रि पार्थिवं रजः पितुरप्रायि धामभिः ।
दिवः सदांसि बृहती वि तिष्ठस आ त्वेषं वर्तते तमः॥
verses.tr: ā rātri pārthivaṃ rajaḥ pituraprāyi dhāmabhiḥ divaḥ sadāṃsi bṛhatī vi tiṣṭhasa ā tveṣaṃ vartate tamaḥ
verses.en: Night! the terrestrial realm hath been filled with the Father's power and might. Thou spreadest forth on high unto the seats of Heaven: darkness that strikes with awe comes near.

verses.sa:
न यस्याः पारं ददृशे न योयुवद् विश्वमस्यां नि विशते यदेजति ।
अरिष्टासस्त उर्वि तमस्वति रात्रि पारमशीमहि भद्रे पारमशीमहि॥
verses.tr: na yasyāḥ pāraṃ dadṛśe na yoyuvad viśvamasyāṃ ni viśate yadejati ariṣṭāsasta urvi tamasvati rātri pāramaśīmahi bhadre pāramaśīmahi
verses.en: Each moving thing finds rest in her whose yonder boundary is not seen, nor that which keeps her separate, O spacious, darksome Night, may we uninjured reach the end of thee, reach, O thou blessed One, thine end. Thy ninety-nine examiners, O Night, who look upon mankind, Eighty-and-eight in number, or seven-and-seventy are they,

verses.sa:
ये ते रात्रि नृचक्षसो द्रष्टारो नवतीर्नव ।
अशीतिः सन्त्यष्टा उतो ते सप्त सप्ततिः॥
verses.tr: ye te rātri nṛcakṣaso draṣṭāro navatīrnava aśītiḥ santyaṣṭā uto te sapta saptatiḥ
verses.en: Sixty-and-six, O opulent, fifty-and-five, O happy One, Forty and-four and thirty-three are they, O thou enriched with spoil,

verses.sa:
षष्टिश्च षट् च रेवति पञ्चाशत् पञ्च सुम्नयि ।
चत्वारश्चत्वारिंशच्च त्रयस्त्रिंशच्च वाजिनि॥
verses.tr: ṣaṣṭiśca ṣaṭ ca revati pañcāśat pañca sumnayi catvāraścatvāriṃśacca trayastriṃśacca vājini
verses.en: Twenty-and-two hast thou, O Night, eleven, yea, and fewer still. With these protectors guard us well. O Daughter of the Sky, to-day.

verses.sa:
द्वौ च ते विंशतिश्च ते रात्र्येकादशावमाः ।
तेभिर्नो अद्य पायुभिर्नु पाहि दुहितर्दिवः॥
verses.tr: dvau ca te viṃśatiśca te rātryekādaśāvamāḥ tebhirno adya pāyubhirnu pāhi duhitardivaḥ
verses.en: Let not a fiends or spiteful man, let no ill-wisher master us. Let not the robber seize our cows, nor the wolf take our sheep to-day.

verses.sa:
रक्षा माकिर्नो अधशंस ईशत मा नो दुःशंस ईशत ।
मा नो अद्य गवां स्तेनो मावीनां वृक ईशत॥
verses.tr: rakṣā mākirno adhaśaṃsa īśata mā no duḥśaṃsa īśata mā no adya gavāṃ steno māvīnāṃ vṛka īśata
verses.en: Let not the thief, O Blessed, seize our horses, nor she-fiends our men, Let thief and robber run away on pathways most remote from us.

verses.sa:
माश्वानां भद्रे तस्करो मा नृणां यातुधान्यः ।
परमेभिः पथिभिः स्तेनो धावतु तस्करः ।
परेण दत्वती रज्जुः परेणाघायुरर्षतु॥
verses.tr: māśvānāṃ bhadre taskaro mā nṛṇāṃ yātudhānyaḥ paramebhiḥ pathibhiḥ steno dhāvatu taskaraḥ pareṇa datvatī rajjuḥ pareṇāghāyurarṣatu
verses.en: Far from us let Rope with Fangs, far from us let the wicked flee. Do thou make blind and headless, Night, the serpent with his pungent breath,

verses.sa:
अध रात्रि तृष्टधूममशीर्षाणमहिं कृणु ।
हनू वृकस्य जम्भयास्तेन तं द्रुपदे जहि॥
verses.tr: adha rātri tṛṣṭadhūmamaśīrṣāṇamahiṃ kṛṇu hanū vṛkasya jambhayāstena taṃ drupade jahi
verses.en: Crush the wolf's jaws in pieces, strike the robber dead against a post, In thee, O Night, do we abide: we here will sleep. Be watchful thou,

verses.sa:
त्वयि रात्रि वसामसि स्वपिष्यामसि जागृहि।
गोभ्यो नः शर्म यच्छाश्वेभ्यः पुरुषेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: tvayi rātri vasāmasi svapiṣyāmasi jāgṛhi gobhyo naḥ śarma yacchāśvebhyaḥ puruṣebhyaḥ
verses.en: Give thou protection to our kine, and to our horses, and our men.

sections.label: A hymn to Night for protection
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 48

verses.sa:
अथो यानि च यस्मा ह यानि चान्तः परीणहि ।
तानि ते परि दद्मसि॥
verses.tr: atho yāni ca yasmā ha yāni cāntaḥ parīṇahi tāni te pari dadmasi
verses.en: Then all that we accumulate, all that the treesurechest contains, All this do we entrust to thee.

verses.sa:
रात्रि मातरुषसे नः परि देहि ।
उषा नो अह्ने परि ददात्वहस्तुभ्यं विभावरि॥
verses.tr: rātri mātaruṣase naḥ pari dehi uṣā no ahne pari dadātvahastubhyaṃ vibhāvari
verses.en: Entrust thou us to Dawn, O Mother Night, May Dawn entrust us to the Day, and Day to thee, O splendid One.

verses.sa:
यत् किं चेदं पतयति यत् किं चेदं सरीसृपम्।
यत् किं च पर्वतायासत्वं तस्मात् त्वं रात्रि पाहि नः॥
verses.tr: yat kiṃ cedaṃ patayati yat kiṃ cedaṃ sarīsṛpam yat kiṃ ca parvatāyāsatvaṃ tasmāt tvaṃ rātri pāhi naḥ
verses.en: Whatever flying thing be here, whatever thing that creeps and crawls. Whatever fastens on a joint, therefrom do thou protect us, Night.

verses.sa:
सा पश्चात् पाहि सा पुरः सोत्तरादधरादुत।
गोपाय नो विभावरि स्तोतारस्त इह स्मसि॥
verses.tr: sā paścāt pāhi sā puraḥ sottarādadharāduta gopāya no vibhāvari stotārasta iha smasi
verses.en: So guard thou us from west and east, protect us from the north and south. O splendid One, preserve: us: we, the singers of thy praise, are here.

verses.sa:
ये रात्रिमनुतिष्ठन्ति ये च भूतेषु जाग्रति ।
पशून् ये सर्वान् रक्षन्ति ते न आत्मसु जाग्रति ते नः पशुषु जाग्रति॥
verses.tr: ye rātrimanutiṣṭhanti ye ca bhūteṣu jāgrati paśūn ye sarvān rakṣanti te na ātmasu jāgrati te naḥ paśuṣu jāgrati
verses.en: They who are followers of Night, and they who watch o'er living things, They who protect all cattle, they keep watch and ward over our lives, over our herds keep watch and ward,

verses.sa:
वेद वै रात्रि ते नाम घृताची नाम वा असि ।
तां त्वां भरद्वाजो वेद सा नो वित्तेऽधि जाग्रति॥
verses.tr: veda vai rātri te nāma ghṛtācī nāma vā asi tāṃ tvāṃ bharadvājo veda sā no vitte'dhi jāgrati
verses.en: Verily, Night, I know thy name, Dropper of Fatness art thou called. Thee Bharadvaja knew as such: as such be watchful o'er our wealth,

sections.label: A hymn of praise and prayer to Night
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 49

verses.sa:
इषिरा योषा युवतिर्दमूना रात्री देवस्य सवितुर्भगस्य ।
अश्वक्षभा सुहवा संभृतश्रीरा पप्रौ द्यावापृथिवी महित्वा॥
verses.tr: iṣirā yoṣā yuvatirdamūnā rātrī devasya saviturbhagasya aśvakṣabhā suhavā saṃbhṛtaśrīrā paprau dyāvāpṛthivī mahitvā
verses.en: Friend of the home, the strong and youthful maiden, Night, dear to Savitar the God, and Bhaga, All-compassing, oil-glorious, prompt to listen, hath with her greatness filled the earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
अति विश्वान्यरुहद् गम्भीरो वर्षिष्ठमरुहन्त श्रविष्ठाः ।
उशती रात्र्यनु सा भद्राभि तिष्ठते मित्र इव स्वधाभिः॥
verses.tr: ati viśvānyaruhad gambhīro varṣiṣṭhamaruhanta śraviṣṭhāḥ uśatī rātryanu sā bhadrābhi tiṣṭhate mitra iva svadhābhiḥ
verses.en: Over all depths hath she gone up, and mounted, most mighty One, the sky's exalted summit. Over me now the loving Night is spreading with her auspicious Godlike ways like Mitra,

verses.sa:
वर्ये वन्दे सुभगे सुजात आजगन् रात्रि सुमना इह स्याम्।
अस्मांस्त्रायस्व नर्याणि जाता अथो यानि गव्यानि पुष्ठ्या॥
verses.tr: varye vande subhage sujāta ājagan rātri sumanā iha syām asmāṃstrāyasva naryāṇi jātā atho yāni gavyāni puṣṭhyā
verses.en: Excellent, high-born, blissful, meet for worship, Night, thou hast come: stay here with friendly spirit, Guard us, the food for men that we have gotten, aud all prosperity that comes of cattle.

verses.sa:
सिंहस्य रात्र्युशती पींषस्य व्याघ्रस्य द्वीपिनो वर्च आ ददे ।
अश्वस्य ब्रध्नं पुरुषस्य मायुं पुरु रूपाणि कृणुषे विभाती॥
verses.tr: siṃhasya rātryuśatī pīṃṣasya vyāghrasya dvīpino varca ā dade aśvasya bradhnaṃ puruṣasya māyuṃ puru rūpāṇi kṛṇuṣe vibhātī
verses.en: With eager haste hath Night assumed the vigour of leopard, tiger, or of tawny lion, 'The horse's neighing and the wild-man's bellow, Thou takest many a form when thou appearest.

verses.sa:
शिवां रात्रिमनुसूर्यं च हिमस्य माता सुहवा नो अस्तु ।
अस्य स्तोमस्य सुभगे नि बोध येन त्वा वन्दे विश्वासु दिक्षु॥
verses.tr: śivāṃ rātrimanusūryaṃ ca himasya mātā suhavā no astu asya stomasya subhage ni bodha yena tvā vande viśvāsu dikṣu
verses.en: Kind through the Night be absence of the sunshine: Mother of Frost, may she be swift to hear us. Take notice of the hymn, thou highly favoured, wherewith I worship thee in all the regions.

verses.sa:
स्तोमस्य नो विभावरि रात्रि राजेव जोषसे ।
आसाम सर्ववीरा भवाम सर्ववेदसो व्युच्छन्तीरनूषसः॥
verses.tr: stomasya no vibhāvari rātri rājeva joṣase āsāma sarvavīrā bhavāma sarvavedaso vyucchantīranūṣasaḥ
verses.en: Even asa King, O splendid Night, thou takest pleasure in our hymn. May we through Mornings as they flush have all our good men round us, and become possessors of all wealth.

verses.sa:
शम्या ह नाम दधिषे मम दिप्सन्ति ये धना ।
रात्रीहि तानसुतपा यस्तेनो न विद्यते यत् पुनर्न विद्यते॥
verses.tr: śamyā ha nāma dadhiṣe mama dipsanti ye dhanā rātrīhi tānasutapā yasteno na vidyate yat punarna vidyate
verses.en: Yea, Ramya is the name thou hast assumed. The men who fain would spoil "My wealth do thou annoy, O Night, that not one robber may appear, none may a second time appear,

verses.sa:
भद्रासि रात्रि चमसो न विष्टो विष्वं गोरूपं युवतिर्बिभर्षि ।
चक्षुष्मती मे उशती वपूंषि प्रति त्वं दिव्या न क्षाममुक्थाः॥
verses.tr: bhadrāsi rātri camaso na viṣṭo viṣvaṃ gorūpaṃ yuvatirbibharṣi cakṣuṣmatī me uśatī vapūṃṣi prati tvaṃ divyā na kṣāmamukthāḥ
verses.en: Thou like a well-wrought cup, O Night, art lovely: thou, a young maid, art formed in perfect beauty. Thou lovingly, for me with eyes to see them, hast bound on thee heaven's stars as thine adornments.

verses.sa:
यो अद्य स्तेन आयत्यघायुर्मर्त्यो रिपुः ।
रात्री तस्य प्रतीत्य प्र ग्रीवाः प्र शिरो हनत्॥
verses.tr: yo adya stena āyatyaghāyurmartyo ripuḥ rātrī tasya pratītya pra grīvāḥ pra śiro hanat
verses.en: Whatever robber comes to-day, mischievous mortal enemy, Let Night go forth, encounter him, and smite away his neck and head;

verses.sa:
प्र पादौ न यथायति प्र हस्तौ न यथाशिषत्।
यो मलिम्लुरुपायति स संपिष्टो अपायति ।
अपायति स्वपायति शुष्के स्थाणावपायति॥
verses.tr: pra pādau na yathāyati pra hastau na yathāśiṣat yo malimlurupāyati sa saṃpiṣṭo apāyati apāyati svapāyati śuṣke sthāṇāvapāyati
verses.en: His feet that he may walk no more, his hands that he may do no harm. The robber who comes hitherward goes crushed and mutilated hence, Goes hence, goes far away. from us, goes hence and bears no spoil away.

sections.label: A hymn to Night for protection and prosperity
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 50

verses.sa:
अध रात्रि तृष्टधूममशीर्षाणमहिं कृणु ।
अक्षौ वृकस्य निर्जह्यास्तेन तं द्रुपदे जहि॥
verses.tr: adha rātri tṛṣṭadhūmamaśīrṣāṇamahiṃ kṛṇu akṣau vṛkasya nirjahyāstena taṃ drupade jahi
verses.en: Blind him and make him headless, Night! the serpent with the pungent breath. Strike from his head the wolf's two eyes, and dash the thief against a post,

verses.sa:
ये ते रात्र्यनड्वाहस्तीक्ष्णशृङ्गाः स्वाशवः ।
तेभिर्नो अद्य पारयाति दुर्गाणि विश्वहा॥
verses.tr: ye te rātryanaḍvāhastīkṣṇaśṛṅgāḥ svāśavaḥ tebhirno adya pārayāti durgāṇi viśvahā
verses.en: Those oxen that are thine, O Night, with sharpened horns and rapid pace, With those transport us safe to-day o'er difficulties everywhere.

verses.sa:
रात्रिंरात्रिमरिष्यन्तस्तरेम तन्वा वयम्।
गम्भीरमप्लवा इव न तरेयुररातयः॥
verses.tr: rātriṃrātrimariṣyantastarema tanvā vayam gambhīramaplavā iva na tareyurarātayaḥ
verses.en: Uninjured in our bodies may we pass through each succeeding night, And let malignities fail to pass, as men without a boat the depth.

verses.sa:
यथा शाम्याकः प्रपतन्नपवान् नानुविद्यते ।
एवा रात्रि प्र पातय यो अस्मां अभ्यघायति॥
verses.tr: yathā śāmyākaḥ prapatannapavān nānuvidyate evā rātri pra pātaya yo asmāṃ abhyaghāyati
verses.en: As millet hurried through the air before us is beheld no more, So cause the man to vanish, Night, who plans to do us injury.

verses.sa:
अप स्तेनं वासो गोअजमुत तस्करम्।
अथो यो अर्वतः शिरोऽभिधाय निनीषति॥
verses.tr: apa stenaṃ vāso goajamuta taskaram atho yo arvataḥ śiro'bhidhāya ninīṣati
verses.en: The thief hast thou kept far away, the robber driver of our kine, Even him who having covered up the horse's head would lead him off.

verses.sa:
यदद्या रात्रि सुभगे विभजन्त्ययो वसु ।
यदेतदस्मान् भोजय यथेदन्यानुपायसि॥
verses.tr: yadadyā rātri subhage vibhajantyayo vasu yadetadasmān bhojaya yathedanyānupāyasi
verses.en: If dealing treasure thou hast come to-day, O highly favoured Night, Cause thou us to enjoy it all so that this may not pass away.

verses.sa:
उषसे नः परि देहि सर्वान् रात्र्यनागसः ।
उषा नो अह्ने आ भजादहस्तुभ्यं विभावरि॥
verses.tr: uṣase naḥ pari dehi sarvān rātryanāgasaḥ uṣā no ahne ā bhajādahastubhyaṃ vibhāvari
verses.en: Do thou entrust us to the Dawn, all of us free from sin, O Night. May Dawn deliver us to Day, and Day to thee, O glorious One.

sections.label: A sacrificial formula
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 51

verses.sa: युतोऽहमयुतो म आत्मायुतं मे चक्षुरयुतं मे श्रोत्रमयुतो मे प्राणोऽयुतो मे ऽपानोऽयुतो मे व्यानोऽयुतोऽहं सर्वः॥
verses.tr: yuto'hamayuto ma ātmāyutaṃ me cakṣurayutaṃ me śrotramayuto me prāṇo'yuto me 'pāno'yuto me vyāno'yuto'haṃ sarvaḥ
verses.en: Undisturbed am I, undisturbed is my soul, undisturbed mine eye, undisturbed mine ear, undisturbed is mine in-breathing, undisturbed mine out-breathing, undisturbed my diffusive breath, undisturbed the whole of me,

verses.sa: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवेऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यां प्रसूत आ रभे॥
verses.tr: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ prasūta ā rabhe
verses.en: Under the impulse of the God Savitar, sent forth from the arms of the Asvins and both hands of Pushan I have taken thee,

sections.label: A hymn to Kama or Desire
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 52

verses.en: Thereafter rose Desire in the beginning, Desire the primal seed and germ of Spirit, O Kama dwelling with the lofty Kama, give growth of riches to the sacrificer.
Thou, Kama, art victorious, famous, potent, splendid, a friend to him who seeks thy friendship. Mighty and overpowering in battle, give strength and vigour to the sacrificer,
They heard his prayers, and they begot, by Kama, heavenly light for him Who from a distance longed for it, a dealer ready to exchange,
O Kama, with whatever wish we make this offering to thee, May it be all fulfilled to us. Then taste this sacrifice. All hail!

sections.label: A hymn to Kama or Time
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 53

verses.sa:
कालो अश्वो वहति सप्तरश्मिः सहस्राक्षो अजरो भूरिरेताः ।
तमा रोहन्ति कवयो विपश्चितस्तस्य चक्रा भुवनानि विश्वा॥
verses.tr: kālo aśvo vahati saptaraśmiḥ sahasrākṣo ajaro bhūriretāḥ tamā rohanti kavayo vipaścitastasya cakrā bhuvanāni viśvā
verses.en: Prolific, thousand-eyed, and undecaying, a horse with seven reins Time bears us onward, Sages inspired with holy knowledge mount him: his chariot wheels are all the worlds of creatures,

verses.sa:
सप्त चक्रान् वहति काल एष सप्तास्य नाभीरमृतं न्वक्षः ।
स इमा विश्वा भुवनान्यञ्जत् कालः स ईयते प्रथमो नु देवः॥
verses.tr: sapta cakrān vahati kāla eṣa saptāsya nābhīramṛtaṃ nvakṣaḥ sa imā viśvā bhuvanānyañjat kālaḥ sa īyate prathamo nu devaḥ
verses.en: This Time hath seven rolling wheels and seven naves immortality is the chariots axle. This Time brings hitherward all worlds about us: as primal Deity is he enrteated

verses.sa:
पूर्णः कुम्भोऽधि काल आहितस्तं वै पश्यामो बहुधा नु सन्तः।
स इमा विश्वा भुवनानि प्रत्यङ्कालं तमाहुः परमे व्योमन्॥
verses.tr: pūrṇaḥ kumbho'dhi kāla āhitastaṃ vai paśyāmo bahudhā nu santaḥ sa imā viśvā bhuvanāni pratyaṅkālaṃ tamāhuḥ parame vyoman
verses.en: On Time is laid an overflowing beaker: this we behold in many a place appearing, He carries from us all these worlds of creatures, They call him Kala in the loftiest heaven,

verses.sa:
स एव सं भुवनान्याभरत् स एव सं भुवनानि पर्यैत्।
पिता सन्नभवत् पुत्र एषां तस्माद् वै नान्यत् परमस्ति तेजः॥
verses.tr: sa eva saṃ bhuvanānyābharat sa eva saṃ bhuvanāni paryait pitā sannabhavat putra eṣāṃ tasmād vai nānyat paramasti tejaḥ
verses.en: He only made the worlds of life, he only gathered the worlds of living things together. Their son did he become who was their Father: no other higher power than he existeth,

verses.sa:
कालोऽमूं दिवमजनयत् काल इमाः पृथिवीरुत।
काले ह भूतं भव्यं चेषितं ह वि तिष्ठते॥
verses.tr: kālo'mūṃ divamajanayat kāla imāḥ pṛthivīruta kāle ha bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ ceṣitaṃ ha vi tiṣṭhate
verses.en: Kala created yonder heaven, and Kala made these realms of earth, By Kala, stirred to motion, both what is and what shall be expand.

verses.sa:
कालो भूतिमसृजत काले तपति सूर्यः ।
काले ह विश्वा भूतानि काले चक्षुर्वि पश्यति॥
verses.tr: kālo bhūtimasṛjata kāle tapati sūryaḥ kāle ha viśvā bhūtāni kāle cakṣurvi paśyati
verses.en: Kala created land: the Sun in Kala hath his light and heat, In Kala rest all things that be: in Kala doth the eye discern.

verses.sa:
काले मनः काले प्राणः काले नाम समाहितम्।
कालेन सर्वा नन्दन्त्यागतेन प्रजा इमाः॥
verses.tr: kāle manaḥ kāle prāṇaḥ kāle nāma samāhitam kālena sarvā nandantyāgatena prajā imāḥ
verses.en: In Kala mind, in Kala breath, in, Kala name are fixt and joined, These living creatures, one and all, rejoice when Kala hath approached.

verses.sa:
काले तपः काले ज्येष्ठं काले ब्रह्म समाहितम्।
कालो ह सर्वस्येश्वरो यः पितासीत् प्रजापतेः॥
verses.tr: kāle tapaḥ kāle jyeṣṭhaṃ kāle brahma samāhitam kālo ha sarvasyeśvaro yaḥ pitāsīt prajāpateḥ
verses.en: Kala embraces Holy Fire, the Highest, Brahma? in himself, Yea, Kala, who was father of Prajapati, is Lord of All.

verses.sa:
तेनेषितं तेन जातं तदु तस्मिन् प्रतिष्ठितम्।
कालो ह ब्रह्म भूत्वा बिभर्ति परमेष्ठिनम्॥
verses.tr: teneṣitaṃ tena jātaṃ tadu tasmin pratiṣṭhitam kālo ha brahma bhūtvā bibharti parameṣṭhinam
verses.en: He made, he stirred this universe to motion, and on him it rests, He, Kala, having now become Brahma, holds Parameshthin up.

verses.sa:
कालः प्रजा असृजत कालो अग्रे प्रजापतिम्।
स्वयंभूः कश्यपः कालात् तपः कालादजायत॥
verses.tr: kālaḥ prajā asṛjata kālo agre prajāpatim svayaṃbhūḥ kaśyapaḥ kālāt tapaḥ kālādajāyata
verses.en: Kala created living things and, first of all, Prajapati. From Kala self-made Kasyapa, from Kala Holy Fire was born.

sections.label: A hymn to Kala j a continuation of the preceding hymn
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 54

verses.en: From Kala sprang the Waters, sprang the regions, Brahma, Holy Fire. The Sun ascends by Ka!a, and in Kala sinks again to rest.
By Kala freshly blows the wind, mighty through Kala is the Earth: Oh Kala rests the mighty Sky.
In Kala erst the text produced what is and what is yet to be. From Kala sprang the Richas, and from Kala was the Yajus born.
They formed in Kala sacrifice, eternal portion for the Gods, "In Kala the Gandharvas and Apsarases and worlds abide.
Atharvan and this Angiras in Kala are supreme o'er heaven, Both this world and the world that is most lofty, the pure worlds and pure intermediate spaces,—
Yea, having conquered all the worlds by Brahma, Kala as God Supreme is supplicated.

sections.label: A hymn to Agni far protection and prosperity
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 55

verses.en: Bringing, as 'twere, with care unceasing fodder night after night to feed this stabled Courser, Joying in food and in the growth of riches, may we thy neighbours, Agni, ne'er be injured.
Here is thine own desire for wealth: through this be gracious unto us. Joying in food and in the growth of riches, may we thy neighbours, Agni, ne'er be injured,
Each eve that comes our household's Lord is Agni, showing his loving-kindness every morning. Bestow upon us treasure after treasure: enkindling thee may we increase thy body,
Each morn that comes our household's Lord is Agni, showing his loving-kindness every evening. Vouchsafe us treasure after treasure: kindling thee may we prosper through a hundred winters,'
Never may I come short of food to feed me, Glory Agni, Rudra, the consumer and the Lord of. food!
Protect my company, protect its courteous members, courteous God! Only through thee, O much-invoked, may I be ever rich in kine,
Only to thee bringing our tribute, Agni, each day as fodder to a stabled courser, Joying in food and in the growth of riches, may we thy neighbours, Agni ne'er be injured,

sections.label: A hymn to Sleep
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 56

verses.sa:
यमस्य लोकादध्या बभूविथ प्रमदा मर्त्यान् प्र युनक्षि धीरः ।
एकाकिना सरथं यासि विद्वान्त्स्वप्नं मिमानो असुरस्य योनौ॥
verses.tr: yamasya lokādadhyā babhūvitha pramadā martyān pra yunakṣi dhīraḥ ekākinā sarathaṃ yāsi vidvāntsvapnaṃ mimāno asurasya yonau
verses.en: Thou art come hither from the world of Yama: thou, resolute, affectest men with rapture. Thou, Sleep, created in the Asura's dwelling, goest, well-knowing, with the solitary.

verses.sa:
बन्धस्त्वाग्रे विश्वचया अपश्यत् पुरा रात्र्या जनितोरेके अह्नि ।
ततः स्वप्नेदमध्या बभूविथ भिषग्भ्यो रूपमपगूहमानः॥
verses.tr: bandhastvāgre viśvacayā apaśyat purā rātryā janitoreke ahni tataḥ svapnedamadhyā babhūvitha bhiṣagbhyo rūpamapagūhamānaḥ
verses.en: At first the all-containing depth beheld thee, ere Night was born, when only Day existed, Thence hast thou come, thence, Sleep, hast thou come hither, concealing, deep within, all form and figure.

verses.sa:
बृहद्गावासुरेभ्योऽधि देवानुपावर्तत महिमानमिच्छन्।
तस्मै स्वप्नाय दधुराधिपत्यं त्रयस्त्रिंशासः स्वरानशानाः॥
verses.tr: bṛhadgāvāsurebhyo'dhi devānupāvartata mahimānamicchan tasmai svapnāya dadhurādhipatyaṃ trayastriṃśāsaḥ svarānaśānāḥ
verses.en: Come from the Asuras in lofty glory, he hath approached the Gods in search of greatness, Winners of heavenly light, the Three-and-thirty endowed this Sleep with his supreme dominion.

verses.sa:
नैतां विदुः पितरो नोत देवा येषां जल्पिश्चरत्यन्तरेदम्।
त्रिते स्वप्नमदधुराप्त्ये नर आदित्यासो वरुणेनानुशिष्टाः॥
verses.tr: naitāṃ viduḥ pitaro nota devā yeṣāṃ jalpiścaratyantaredam trite svapnamadadhurāptye nara ādityāso varuṇenānuśiṣṭāḥ
verses.en: Of him nor Fathers nor the Gods have knowledge, the Gods whose gentle talk is still about him. Urged by command of Varuna the Adityas, Heroes, transported Sleep to Trita Aptya.

verses.sa:
यस्य क्रूरमभजन्त दुष्कृतोऽस्वप्नेन सुकृतः पुण्यमायुः ।
स्वर्मदसि परमेण बन्धुना तप्यमानस्य मनसोऽधि जज्ञिषे॥
verses.tr: yasya krūramabhajanta duṣkṛto'svapnena sukṛtaḥ puṇyamāyuḥ svarmadasi parameṇa bandhunā tapyamānasya manaso'dhi jajñiṣe
verses.en: Thou whose severity hath reached ill-doers, and whose reward the good have gained in slumber, Delightest heaven with thy most lofty kinship, born from his spirit who was worn and weary.

verses.sa:
विद्म ते सर्वाः परिजाः पुरस्ताद् विद्म स्वप्न यो अधिपा इहा ते ।
यशश्विनो नो यशसेह पाह्याराद् द्विषेभिरप याहि दूरम्॥
verses.tr: vidma te sarvāḥ parijāḥ purastād vidma svapna yo adhipā ihā te yaśaśvino no yaśaseha pāhyārād dviṣebhirapa yāhi dūram
verses.en: Of old we know all places whence thou comest, O Sleep, we know him who is here thy ruler, Protect us here illustrious with glory, Go, from afar, with poisons, into distance.

sections.label: A charm against evil dreams
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 57

verses.en: As men discharge the utmost debt, collect the eighth and sixteenth part, Soto the foeman we transfer together all the evil dream,
Princes came together, debts came together, Kushtha came together, Sixteenths came together, The whole evil dream that hath visited us we send away as a bad dream to the man who hates us.
Child of Gods' Consorts, minister of Yama is the good Dream: that which is my trouble we drive away to the enemy,

Thou whose name is Rough art the mouth of the Black Bird. As such we know thee, Dream, as such we know thee. well, Like a horse art thou, O Dream. As they bind girth and surcingle on a horse, so bind the alien mischief-maker, the scorner of the Gods.
The evil dream that threatens us, threatens our cattle or our home, That let the scorner of the Gods, the alien mischief-maker bind as a gold jewel round his neck.
Having measured off nine cubits' distance from us we give away the whole of the evil dream to the man who hates us.

sections.label: A prayer for prosperity, accompanying a sacrifice
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 58

verses.sa:
घृतस्य जूतिः समना सदेवा संवत्सरं हविषा वर्धयन्ती ।
श्रोत्रं चक्षुः प्राणोच्छिन्नो नो अस्त्वच्छिन्ना वयमायुषो वर्चसः॥
verses.tr: ghṛtasya jūtiḥ samanā sadevā saṃvatsaraṃ haviṣā vardhayantī śrotraṃ cakṣuḥ prāṇocchinno no astvacchinnā vayamāyuṣo varcasaḥ
verses.en: Still equal be the flow of butter ever causing the Year to prosper with oblation. Still be our hearing, sight, and breath uninjured: let us lose nothing of our life and vigour.

verses.sa:
उपास्मान् प्राणो ह्वयतामुप वयं प्राणं हवामहे ।
वर्चो जग्राह पृथिव्य१न्तरिक्षं वर्चः सोमो बृहस्पतिर्विधत्ता॥
verses.tr: upāsmān prāṇo hvayatāmupa vayaṃ prāṇaṃ havāmahe varco jagrāha pṛthivya1ntarikṣaṃ varcaḥ somo bṛhaspatirvidhattā
verses.en: Let lively breath invite us: we call vital breath to visit us. Earth and air's middle realm have gathered, Soma, Brihaspati and Dhartar gathered vigour.

verses.sa:
वर्चसो द्यावापृथिवी संग्रहणी बभूवथुर्वर्चो गृहीत्वा पृथिवीमनु सं चरेम ।
यशसं गावो गोपतिमुप तिष्ठन्त्यायतीर्यशो गृहीत्वा पृथिवीमनु सं चरेम॥
verses.tr: varcaso dyāvāpṛthivī saṃgrahaṇī babhūvathurvarco gṛhītvā pṛthivīmanu saṃ carema yaśasaṃ gāvo gopatimupa tiṣṭhantyāyatīryaśo gṛhītvā pṛthivīmanu saṃ carema
verses.en: The earth and heaven have come to be two gatherers up of vigorous might. So let us gather vigour up and closely follow after Earth, With glory come the cows and stand beside the master of the herd, Let us when we have gathered fame and glory closely follow Earth.

verses.sa:
व्रजं कृणुध्वं स हि वो नृपाणो वर्मा सीव्यध्वं बहुला पृथूनि ।
पुरः कृणुध्वमायसीरधृष्टा मा वः सुस्रोच्चमसो दृंहता तम्॥
verses.tr: vrajaṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ sa hi vo nṛpāṇo varmā sīvyadhvaṃ bahulā pṛthūni puraḥ kṛṇudhvamāyasīradhṛṣṭā mā vaḥ susroccamaso dṛṃhatā tam
verses.en: Prepare the cow-stall, for there drink your heroes: stitch ye the coats of armour wide and many, Make iron forts defying all assailants: let not your pitcher leak; stay it securely,

verses.sa:
यज्ञस्य चक्षुः प्रभृतिर्मुखं च वाचा श्रोत्रेण मनसा जुहोमि ।
इमं यज्ञं विततं विश्वकर्मणा देवा यन्तु सुमनस्यमानाः॥
verses.tr: yajñasya cakṣuḥ prabhṛtirmukhaṃ ca vācā śrotreṇa manasā juhomi imaṃ yajñaṃ vitataṃ viśvakarmaṇā devā yantu sumanasyamānāḥ
verses.en: The eye of sacrifice, source and beginning with voice, car, spirit unto him I offer. To this our sacrifice, wrought by Visvakarman, may the Gods-come gracious and kindly-hearted,

verses.sa:
ये देवानामृत्विजो ये च यज्ञिया येभ्यो हव्यं क्रियते भागधेयम्।
इमं यज्ञं सह पत्नीभिरेत्य यावन्तो देवास्तविषा मादयन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: ye devānāmṛtvijo ye ca yajñiyā yebhyo havyaṃ kriyate bhāgadheyam imaṃ yajñaṃ saha patnībhiretya yāvanto devāstaviṣā mādayantām
verses.en: Let the Gods' Priests and those who merit worship, to whom oblation as their share is offered, Come to this holy service with their Consorts, and all Gods revel in the food we bring them.

sections.label: An expiatory hymn accompanying sacrifice
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 59

verses.sa: त्वमग्ने व्रतपा असि देव आ मर्त्येष्वा। त्वं यज्ञेष्वीड्यः॥
verses.tr: tvamagne vratapā asi deva ā martyeṣvā tvaṃ yajñeṣvīḍyaḥ
verses.en: God among mortals, Agni, thou art guard of holy Law, thou art To be adored in sacred rites,

verses.sa:
यद् वो वयं प्रमिनाम व्रतानि विदुषां देवा अविदुष्टरासः ।
अग्निष्टद् विश्वादा पृणातु विद्वान्त्सोमस्य यो ब्राह्मणां आविवेश॥
verses.tr: yad vo vayaṃ pramināma vratāni viduṣāṃ devā aviduṣṭarāsaḥ agniṣṭad viśvādā pṛṇātu vidvāntsomasya yo brāhmaṇāṃ āviveśa
verses.en: When, ignorant, we violate the statutes of you, O Deities, with whom is knowledge, Wise Agni shall correct our faults and failings, and Soma who hath entered into Brahmans.

verses.sa:
आ देवानामपि पन्थामगन्म यच्छक्नवाम तदनुप्रवोढुम्।
अग्निर्विद्वान्त्स यजात् स इद्धोता सोऽध्वरान्त्स ऋतून् कल्पयाति॥
verses.tr: ā devānāmapi panthāmaganma yacchaknavāma tadanupravoḍhum agnirvidvāntsa yajāt sa iddhotā so'dhvarāntsa ṛtūn kalpayāti
verses.en: To the Gods' pathway have we come desiring to execute what work we may accomplish. Let Agni—for he knows—complete the worship. He is the Priest: let him fix rites and seasons,

sections.label: A prayer for perfect bodily an8 mental health and vigour
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 60

verses.sa:
वाङ् म आसन् नसोः प्राणश्चक्षुरक्ष्णोः श्रोत्रं कर्णयोः ।
अपलिताः केशा अशोणा दन्ता बहु बाह्वोर्बलम्॥
verses.tr: vāṅ ma āsan nasoḥ prāṇaścakṣurakṣṇoḥ śrotraṃ karṇayoḥ apalitāḥ keśā aśoṇā dantā bahu bāhvorbalam
verses.en: May I have voice in my mouth, breath in my nostrils, sight in mine eyes, hearing' in mine ears, hair that hath not turned gray, teeth free from yellowness, and much strength in mine arms.

verses.sa:
ऊर्वोरोजो जङ्घयोर्जवः पादयोः ।
प्रतिष्ठा अरिष्टानि मे सर्वात्मानिभृष्टः॥
verses.tr: ūrvorojo jaṅghayorjavaḥ pādayoḥ pratiṣṭhā ariṣṭāni me sarvātmānibhṛṣṭaḥ
verses.en: May I have power in my thighs, swiftness in my legs, stedfastness in my feet. May all my members be uninjured and my soul unimpaired.

sections.label: A prayer for long life, prosperity and final happiness in heaven
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 61

verses.sa:
तनूस्तन्वा मे सहे दतः सर्वमायुरशीय ।
स्योनं मे सीद पुरुः पृणस्व पवमानः स्वर्गे॥
verses.tr: tanūstanvā me sahe dataḥ sarvamāyuraśīya syonaṃ me sīda puruḥ pṛṇasva pavamānaḥ svarge
verses.en: May' my self remain in my body: may I enjoy the full time of life, Rest thee pleasantly: pour forth abundance, purifying thyself in Svarga,

sections.label: A prayer for the love of Gods and men
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 62

verses.sa:
प्रियं मा कृणु देवेषु प्रियं राजसु मा कृणु ।
प्रियं सर्वस्य पश्यत उत शूद्र उतार्ये॥
verses.tr: priyaṃ mā kṛṇu deveṣu priyaṃ rājasu mā kṛṇu priyaṃ sarvasya paśyata uta śūdra utārye
verses.en: Make me beloved among the Gods, beloved among the Princes, make Me dear to everyone who sees, to Sudra and to Aryan man.

sections.label: A prayer, with sacrifice, for long life and prosperity
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 63

verses.sa:
उत् तिष्ठ ब्रह्मणस्पते देवान् यज्ञेन बोधय ।
आयुः प्राणं प्रजां पशून् कीर्तिं यजमानं च वर्धय॥
verses.tr: ut tiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate devān yajñena bodhaya āyuḥ prāṇaṃ prajāṃ paśūn kīrtiṃ yajamānaṃ ca vardhaya
verses.en: Rise up, O Brahmanaspati; awake the Gods with sacrifice. Strengthen the Sacrificer: aid life, breath, and offspring, cattle, fame,

sections.label: A prayer to Agni for children, long life, and various blessings
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 64

verses.sa:
अग्ने समिधमाहार्षं बृहते जातवेदसे ।
स मे श्रद्धां च मेधां च जातवेदाः प्र यच्छतु॥
verses.tr: agne samidhamāhārṣaṃ bṛhate jātavedase sa me śraddhāṃ ca medhāṃ ca jātavedāḥ pra yacchatu
verses.en: For lofty Jatavedas I have brought the fuel hither first. May he who knoweth all bestow faith and intelligence on me,

verses.sa:
इध्मेन त्वा जातवेदः समिधा वर्धयामसि ।
तथा त्वमस्मान् वर्धय प्रजया च धनेन च॥
verses.tr: idhmena tvā jātavedaḥ samidhā vardhayāmasi tathā tvamasmān vardhaya prajayā ca dhanena ca
verses.en: With fuel and with flaming wood we, Jatavedas, strengthen thee; So do thou strengthen us in turn with children and with store of wealth,

verses.sa:
यदग्ने यानि कानि चिदा ते दारूणि दध्मसि ।
सर्वं तदस्तु मे शिवं तज्जुषस्व यविष्ठ्य॥
verses.tr: yadagne yāni kāni cidā te dārūṇi dadhmasi sarvaṃ tadastu me śivaṃ tajjuṣasva yaviṣṭhya
verses.en: Whatever even be the logs which, Agni, we lay down for thee, Propitious be it all to me: accept it, O most youthful God.

verses.sa:
एतास्ते अग्ने समिधस्त्वमिद्धः समिद् भव ।
आयुरस्मासु धेह्यमृतत्वमाचार्याय॥
verses.tr: etāste agne samidhastvamiddhaḥ samid bhava āyurasmāsu dhehyamṛtatvamācāryāya
verses.en: Agni, these logs are thine: with these be, fain to burn! a flaming brand. Vouchsafe us length of life and give us hope of immortality. A. prayer for the love of Gods and men.

sections.label: A hymn to Agni as the Sun
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 65

verses.sa:
हरिः सुपर्णो दिवमारुहोऽर्चिषा ये त्वा दिप्सन्ति दिवमुत्पतन्तम्।
अव तां जहि हरसा जातवेदोऽबिभ्यदुग्रोऽर्चिषा दिवमा रोह सूर्य॥
verses.tr: hariḥ suparṇo divamāruho'rciṣā ye tvā dipsanti divamutpatantam ava tāṃ jahi harasā jātavedo'bibhyadugro'rciṣā divamā roha sūrya
verses.en: A Golden Eagle thou hast soared with light to heaven. Those who would harm thee as thou fliest skyward Beat down, O Jatavedas, with thy fury, The strong hath feared: to heaven mount up with light, O Sarya,

sections.label: A hymn to Agni identified with the Sun
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 66

verses.sa:
अयोजाला असुरा मायिनोऽयस्मयैः पाशैरङ्किनो ये चरन्ति ।
तांस्ते रन्धयामि हरसा जातवेदः सहस्रऋष्टिः सपत्नान् प्रमृणन् पाहि वज्रः॥
verses.tr: ayojālā asurā māyino'yasmayaiḥ pāśairaṅkino ye caranti tāṃste randhayāmi harasā jātavedaḥ sahasraṛṣṭiḥ sapatnān pramṛṇan pāhi vajraḥ
verses.en: The Asuras with iron nets, magicians, who roam about with hooks and bonds of iron, With wrath I make thy thralls, O Jatavedas, Come as a bolt foe-quelling, thousand pointed.

sections.label: A prayer for long life
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 67

verses.sa: पश्येम शरदः शतम्॥
verses.tr: paśyema śaradaḥ śatam
verses.en: A Hundred autumns may we see.

verses.sa: जीवेम शरदः शतम्॥
verses.tr: jīvema śaradaḥ śatam
verses.en: A hundred autumns may we live.

verses.sa: बुध्येम शरदः शतम्॥
verses.tr: budhyema śaradaḥ śatam
verses.en: A hundred autumns may we know.

verses.sa: रोहेम शरदः शतम्॥
verses.tr: rohema śaradaḥ śatam
verses.en: A hundred autumns may we grow,

verses.sa: पूषेम शरदः शतम्॥
verses.tr: pūṣema śaradaḥ śatam
verses.en: A hundred autumns may we thrive,

verses.sa: भवेम शरदः शतम्॥
verses.tr: bhavema śaradaḥ śatam
verses.en: A hundred autumns may we be,

verses.sa: भूयेम शरदः शतम्॥
verses.tr: bhūyema śaradaḥ śatam
verses.en: A hundred autumns may we bide,

verses.sa: भूयसीः शरदः शतात्॥
verses.tr: bhūyasīḥ śaradaḥ śatāt
verses.en: A hundred, yea, and even more,

sections.label: A preliminary sacrificial formula
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 68

verses.sa:
अव्यसश्च व्यचसश्च बिलं वि ष्यामि मायया ।
ताभ्यामुद्धृत्य वेदमथ कर्माणि कृण्महे॥
verses.tr: avyasaśca vyacasaśca bilaṃ vi ṣyāmi māyayā tābhyāmuddhṛtya vedamatha karmāṇi kṛṇmahe
verses.en: Both of broad and narrow I with magic power unclose the mouth. With these when we have raised the bunch of grass we pay the holy rites,

sections.label: A prayer or charm for long life
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 69

verses.sa: जीवा स्थ जीव्यासं सर्वमायुर्जीव्यासम्॥
verses.tr: jīvā stha jīvyāsaṃ sarvamāyurjīvyāsam
verses.en: Ye are alive. I fain would live. I fain would live my complete term of life.

verses.sa: उपजीवा स्थोप जीव्यासं सर्वमायुर्जीव्यासम्॥
verses.tr: upajīvā sthopa jīvyāsaṃ sarvamāyurjīvyāsam
verses.en: Ye live dependent. I fain would live dependent, I fain would live my complete term of life.

verses.sa: संजीवा स्थ सं जीव्यासं सर्वमायुर्जीव्यासम्॥
verses.tr: saṃjīvā stha saṃ jīvyāsaṃ sarvamāyurjīvyāsam
verses.en: Ye remain alive, I fain would remain alive. I fain would live my complete term of life,

verses.sa: जीवला स्थ जीव्यासं सर्वमायुर्जीव्यासम्॥
verses.tr: jīvalā stha jīvyāsaṃ sarvamāyurjīvyāsam
verses.en: Ye are life-givers, I fain would live, I fain would live my complete term of life, f

sections.label: A charm for long life
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 70

verses.sa:
इन्द्र जीव सूर्य जीव देवा जीवा जीव्यासमहम्।
सर्वमायुर्जीव्यासम्॥
verses.tr: indra jīva sūrya jīva devā jīvā jīvyāsamaham sarvamāyurjīvyāsam
verses.en: Live, Indra, Live. Surya, Live, ye Gods. I fain would live, Fain would I live my complete term of life,

sections.label: A hymn, accompanying libations
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 71

verses.sa:
स्तुता मया वरदा वेदमाता प्र चोदयन्तां पावमानी द्विजानाम्।
आयुः प्राणं प्रजां पशुं कीर्तिं द्रविणं ब्रह्मवर्चसम्।
मह्यं दत्त्वा व्रजत ब्रह्मलोकम्॥
verses.tr: stutā mayā varadā vedamātā pra codayantāṃ pāvamānī dvijānām āyuḥ prāṇaṃ prajāṃ paśuṃ kīrtiṃ draviṇaṃ brahmavarcasam mahyaṃ dattvā vrajata brahmalokam
verses.en: Let my libations, giving boons, adoring, further the Twice-born's song that honours Soma. Go ye to Brahma's world having enriched me with life and breath, with children and with cattle, with fame and wealth, and with a Brahman's lustre.

sections.label: A hymn, accompanying libations, for wealth and prosperity
sections.name: Book 19, hymn 72

verses.sa:
यस्मात् कोशादुदभराम वेदं तस्मिन्नन्तरव दध्म एनम्।
कृतमिष्टं ब्रह्मणो वीर्येण तेन मा देवास्तपसावतेह॥
verses.tr: yasmāt kośādudabharāma vedaṃ tasminnantarava dadhma enam kṛtamiṣṭaṃ brahmaṇo vīryeṇa tena mā devāstapasāvateha
verses.en: Within the chest whence we before extracted the bunch of grass, this do we now deposit, Wrought is the sacrifice by power of Brahma. Through this assist me here, ye Gods, with Fervour.
